title.zh: 卷二 本紀第二 太祖二
title.raw: 卷二 本紀第二 太祖二 Volume 2 Annals 2: Taizu 2

sentences.zh: 洪武元年春正月乙亥，祀天地於南郊，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, spring, the first month, on the day yihai, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb, and the imperial throne was assumed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the first day of the first month of spring in the inaugural year of Hongwu, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb and took the throne.

sentences.zh: 定有天下之號曰明，建元洪武。

translations.literal: The title of possessing All-under-Heaven was fixed as Ming, and the era name Hongwu was established.
translations.idiomatic: He fixed the name of the realm as Ming and proclaimed the Hongwu era.

sentences.zh: 追尊高祖考曰玄皇帝，廟號德祖，曾祖考曰恆皇帝，廟號懿祖；

translations.literal: The high ancestor father was posthumously honored as Emperor Xuan, with temple name Dezu; the great-grandfather father was honored as Emperor Heng, with temple name Yizu;
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously honored his great-great-grandfather as Emperor Xuan, temple name Dezu, and his great-grandfather as Emperor Heng, temple name Yizu;

sentences.zh: 祖考曰裕皇帝，廟號熙祖，皇考曰淳皇帝，廟號仁祖，妣皆皇后。

translations.literal: The grandfather father was called Emperor Yu, temple name Xizu; the imperial father was called Emperor Chun, temple name Renzu; the mothers were all empresses.
translations.idiomatic: his grandfather as Emperor Yu, temple name Xizu, and his father as Emperor Chun, temple name Renzu, with all their consorts honored as empresses.

sentences.zh: 立妃馬氏為皇后，世子標為皇太子。

translations.literal: Consort Ma was established as empress, and the heir Biao as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: He installed Lady Ma as empress and his heir Biao as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 以李善長、徐達為左、右丞相，諸功臣進爵有差。

translations.literal: Li Shanchang and Xu Da were made left and right chief ministers; the various meritorious officials were advanced in rank with differences.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed Li Shanchang and Xu Da left and right chief ministers and raised the founding ministers to peerages in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 丙子，頒即位詔於天下。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the accession edict was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he issued his accession edict to the entire empire.

sentences.zh: 追封皇伯考以下皆為王。

translations.literal: The imperial father's elder brothers and below were posthumously enfeoffed as kings.
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously enfeoffed his father's elder brothers and their descendants as princes.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，李善長、徐達等兼東宮官。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Li Shanchang, Xu Da, and others also held Eastern Palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Shanchang, Xu Da, and others were given concurrent posts in the crown prince's household.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遣使覈浙西田賦。

translations.literal: On jiashen, envoys were dispatched to verify the land tax of western Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he sent officials to audit land-tax registers in western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，胡廷瑞克建寧。

translations.literal: On renchen, Hu Tingrui captured Jianning.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Hu Tingrui took Jianning.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈為征戍將軍，略南陽以北州郡。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Deng Yu became campaigning garrison general and reduced the prefectures north of Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Deng Yu was named campaigning garrison general to subdue the prefectures north of Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 湯和克延平，執元平章陳友定，福建平。

translations.literal: Tang He captured Yanping, seized the Yuan pingzhang Chen Youding, and Fujian was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Tang He took Yanping, captured the Yuan minister Chen Youding, and pacified Fujian.

sentences.zh: 是月，天下府州縣官來朝。

translations.literal: That month, officials of prefectures, departments, and counties throughout the realm came to court.
translations.idiomatic: That month magistrates from across the empire presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「天下始定，民財力俱困，要在休養安息，惟廉者能約己而利人，勉之。

translations.literal: An instruction said: 'The realm has just been settled; the people's wealth and strength are both exhausted. What matters is to rest and let them recover. Only the incorrupt can restrain themselves and benefit others—exert yourselves.'
translations.idiomatic: He admonished them: "The empire has only just been pacified, and the people's resources are exhausted. Your task is to let them recuperate in peace. Only the upright can discipline themselves and serve the public—see that you do so."

sentences.zh: 」二月壬寅，定郊社宗廟禮，歲必親祀，以為常。

translations.literal: 'In the second month, on renyin, the rites for the suburban altars, the altars of soil and grain, and the ancestral temples were fixed; each year the emperor must personally sacrifice, and this was made the rule.
translations.idiomatic: " On renyin in the second month he established the rites for the suburban sacrifices, the altars of soil and grain, and the ancestral temples, decreeing that he would perform them in person every year as a standing practice.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，湯和提督海運。

translations.literal: On guimao, Tang He supervised sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Tang He was put in charge of maritime grain transport.

sentences.zh: 廖永忠為征南將軍，硃亮祖副之，由海道取廣東。

translations.literal: Liao Yongzhong became southern campaign general, with Zhu Liangzu as his deputy, taking Guangdong by the sea route.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Yongzhong was appointed southern campaign general with Zhu Liangzu as his second, to seize Guangdong by sea.

sentences.zh: 丁未，乙太牢祀先師孔子於國學。

translations.literal: On dingwei, with the yi offering of the great victim, the former teacher Confucius was sacrificed to at the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he offered the great victim to Confucius at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祀社稷。

translations.literal: On wushen, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he sacrificed to the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔衣冠如唐制。

translations.literal: On renzi, an edict ordered caps and robes according to Tang regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he decreed court dress after the Tang model.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，常遇春克東昌，山東平。

translations.literal: On guichou, Chang Yuchun captured Dongchang, and Shandong was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Chang Yuchun took Dongchang and pacified Shandong.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，楊璟克寶慶。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Yang Jing captured Baoqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Yang Jing took Baoqing.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，詔儒臣修女誡，戒後妃毋預政。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinwei, an edict ordered Confucian officials to compile Admonitions for Women, warning empresses and consorts not to interfere in government.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, he ordered scholar-officials to compile Admonitions for Women and forbade imperial consorts to meddle in affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 壬申，周德興克全州。

translations.literal: On renshen, Zhou Dexing captured Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Zhou Dexing took Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，鄧愈克南陽。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Deng Yu captured Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Deng Yu took Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，徐達徇汴梁，左君弼降。

translations.literal: On jihai, Xu Da marched on Bianliang, and Zuo Junbi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Xu Da advanced on Bianliang, and Zuo Junbi submitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，蘄州進竹簟，卻之，命四方毋妄獻。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on xinchou, Qizhou presented bamboo mats; they were declined, and the four quarters were ordered not to present gifts recklessly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinchou, Qizhou offered bamboo mats; he refused them and ordered the provinces to stop sending unsolicited tribute.

sentences.zh: 廖永忠師至廣州，元守臣何真降，廣東平。

translations.literal: Liao Yongzhong's army reached Guangzhou; the Yuan defending official He Zhen surrendered, and Guangdong was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When Liao Yongzhong's forces reached Guangzhou, the Yuan defender He Zhen surrendered and Guangdong was pacified.

sentences.zh: 丁未，祫享太廟。

translations.literal: On dingwei, a collective offering was made at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he performed the collective ancestral rite in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徐達、常遇春大破元兵於洛水北，遂圍河南。

translations.literal: On wushen, Xu Da and Chang Yuchun greatly defeated Yuan troops north of the Luo River, then besieged Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Xu Da and Chang Yuchun routed the Yuan army north of the Luo and laid siege to Henan.

sentences.zh: 梁王阿魯溫降，河南平。

translations.literal: Prince of Liang Aruwen surrendered, and Henan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Liang, Aruwen, surrendered, and Henan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，楊璟克永州。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Yang Jing captured Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Yang Jing took Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸汴梁。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the emperor visited Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he traveled to Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，馮勝克潼關，李思齊、張思道遁。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Feng Sheng captured Tong Pass; Li Siqi and Zhang Sidao fled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Feng Sheng took Tong Pass while Li Siqi and Zhang Sidao fled.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，廖永忠下梧州，潯、貴、容、郁林諸州皆降。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao, Liao Yongzhong took Wuzhou; the prefectures Xun, Gui, Rong, and Yulin all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, Liao Yongzhong captured Wuzhou, and the prefectures of Xun, Gui, Rong, and Yulin all submitted.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，改汴梁路為開封府。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the Bianliang circuit was changed to Kaifeng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he redesignated the Bianliang circuit as Kaifeng prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，徐達朝行在。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengzi, Xu Da attended the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengzi, Xu Da presented himself at the temporary capital.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，海南、海北諸道降。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the circuits of Hainan and Haibei surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Hainan and Haibei circuits submitted.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，楊璟、硃亮祖克靖江。

translations.literal: On renxu, Yang Jing and Zhu Liangzu captured Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Yang Jing and Zhu Liangzu took Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，廖永忠下象州，廣西平。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on wuzi, Liao Yongzhong took Xiangzhou, and Guangxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuzi, Liao Yongzhong captured Xiangzhou and pacified Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，振恤中原貧民。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the poor people of the central plains were relieved and succored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he provided relief to the impoverished of the central plains.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，將還應天，諭達等曰：「中原之民，久為群雄所苦，流離相望，故命將北征，拯民水火。

translations.literal: On xinmao, about to return to Yingtian, he instructed Xu Da and others: 'The people of the central plains have long suffered from the warlords, wandering homeless and gazing at one another; therefore generals were ordered on the northern expedition to rescue the people from flood and fire.'
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, as he prepared to return to Yingtian, he told Xu Da and the others: "The people of the central plains have long been tormented by rival warlords, displaced and destitute. That is why I sent you north—to lift them out of misery."

sentences.zh: 元祖宗功德在人，其子孫罔恤民隱，天厭棄之。

translations.literal: The Yuan founding ancestors' merit and virtue remain among the people, but their descendants paid no heed to the people's hidden suffering; Heaven grew weary and abandoned them.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan founders' beneficence still lives in men's memory, yet their heirs ignored the people's plight until Heaven itself turned against them.

sentences.zh: 君則有罪，民復何辜。

translations.literal: The ruler alone is guilty; what crime have the people again?
translations.idiomatic: The fault lies with the rulers—what wrong have the common people done?

sentences.zh: 前代革命之際，肆行屠戮，違天虐民，朕實不忍。

translations.literal: At the revolutions of former ages, slaughter was carried out wantonly, violating Heaven and mistreating the people; We truly cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: In past dynastic upheavals armies butchered without restraint, defying Heaven and crushing the people—something I cannot bring myself to do.

sentences.zh: 諸將克城，毋肆焚掠妄殺人，元之宗戚，咸俾保全。

translations.literal: When the generals capture cities, they must not recklessly burn, plunder, or kill people; the Yuan imperial kin are all to be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: When you take a city, do not burn, loot, or kill indiscriminately, and see that the Yuan imperial clan are all kept safe.

sentences.zh: 庶幾上答天心，下慰人望，以副朕伐罪安民之意。

translations.literal: Thus perhaps above Heaven's heart will be answered, below the people's hopes will be comforted, fulfilling Our intent to punish crime and settle the people.
translations.idiomatic: In this way you may answer Heaven above and satisfy the people's hopes below, and fulfill my aim of punishing the guilty while bringing peace to the people.

sentences.zh: 不恭命者，罰無赦。

translations.literal: Those who do not respect the command—punishment without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever disobeys this order will be punished without mercy.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，命馮勝留守開封。

translations.literal: 'On bingchen, Feng Sheng was ordered to remain and guard Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingchen he ordered Feng Sheng to stay behind and garrison Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁未，至自開封。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on dingwei, he arrived from Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingwei, he returned from Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 己酉，徐達會諸將兵於臨清。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Xu Da assembled the generals' troops at Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Xu Da gathered the commanders' forces at Linqing.

sentences.zh: 壬子，常遇春克德州。

translations.literal: On renzi, Chang Yuchun captured Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Chang Yuchun took Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，克通州，元帝趨上都。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Tongzhou was captured; the Yuan emperor hastened to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin they took Tongzhou, and the Yuan emperor fled toward Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 是月，征天下賢才為守令。

translations.literal: That month, worthy talent throughout the realm was recruited as prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: That month he summoned men of talent from across the empire to serve as prefects and magistrates.

sentences.zh: 免吳江、慶德、太平、甯國、滁、和被災田租。

translations.literal: Land tax was remitted for disaster-stricken fields in Wujiang, Qingde, Taiping, Ningguo, Chu, and He.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted land tax on fields stricken by disaster in Wujiang, Qingde, Taiping, Ningguo, Chu, and He prefectures.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，以應天為南京，開封為北京。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jisi, Yingtian was made Southern Capital and Kaifeng Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi, he designated Yingtian the Southern Capital and Kaifeng the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚午，徐達入元都，封府庫圖籍，守宮門，禁士卒侵暴，遣將巡古北口諸隘。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Xu Da entered the Yuan capital, sealed the treasuries and archives, guarded the palace gates, forbade soldiers from violence, and dispatched generals to patrol the passes at Gubeikou and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Xu Da entered the Yuan capital, sealed the treasuries and archives, secured the palace gates, forbade looting by the troops, and sent generals to patrol the passes at Gubeikou and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以京師火，四方水旱，詔中書省集議便民事。

translations.literal: On renshen, because of fire in the capital and flood and drought in the four quarters, the Secretariat was ordered to assemble and discuss measures convenient for the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, in response to fires in the capital and floods and droughts in the provinces, he ordered the Secretariat to deliberate measures to ease the people's burdens.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，定六部官制。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the official system of the Six Ministries was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he established the bureaucratic structure of the Six Ministries.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞劉基致仕。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Liu Ji retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji, vice censor-in-chief, retired from office.

sentences.zh: 己卯，赦殊死以下。

translations.literal: On jimao, those below the penalty of special death were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he granted amnesty for all crimes short of capital offenses.

sentences.zh: 將士從征者恤其家，逋逃許自首。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers who followed the campaign had their families relieved; fugitives were permitted to surrender themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Families of soldiers on campaign were granted relief, and fugitives were allowed to turn themselves in.

sentences.zh: 新克州郡毋妄殺。

translations.literal: In newly captured prefectures and districts, killing without cause was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Indiscriminate killing was forbidden in newly conquered prefectures.

sentences.zh: 輸賦道遠者，官為轉運，災荒以實聞。

translations.literal: Those paying tax from distant routes—the government would transport for them; disasters and famine were to be reported according to fact.
translations.idiomatic: Where taxpayers lived far from collection points, officials would arrange transport of grain; reports of disaster and famine had to reflect actual conditions.

sentences.zh: 免鎮江租稅。

translations.literal: Zhenjiang's rent and tax were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted rent and tax in Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 避亂民復業者，聽墾荒地，復三年。

translations.literal: People who fled disorder and returned to their occupations were permitted to reclaim wasteland, with exemption for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees returning to their livelihoods were allowed to open wasteland with a three-year tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 衍聖公襲封及授曲阜知縣，並如前代制。

translations.literal: The Duke Who Continues the Sage's line received hereditary enfeoffment and appointment as magistrate of Qufu, all as in former dynasties' regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Confucius' line received hereditary enfeoffment and appointment as magistrate of Qufu, following precedent of earlier dynasties.

sentences.zh: 有司以禮聘致賢士，學校毋事虛文。

translations.literal: The responsible offices were to invite worthy scholars with ritual courtesy; schools were not to engage in empty forms.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials were to recruit worthy men with proper ceremony, and schools were to eschew empty formalism.

sentences.zh: 平刑，毋非時決囚。

translations.literal: Punishments were to be made equitable; prisoners were not to be executed out of season.
translations.idiomatic: Punishments were to be applied fairly, and executions were not to be carried out at improper times.

sentences.zh: 除書籍田器稅，民間逋負免征。

translations.literal: Tax on books and farm tools was abolished; private arrears were exempted from collection.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes on books and farm implements were abolished, and private debts in arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 蒙古、色目人有才能者，許擢用。

translations.literal: Mongols and Semuren with ability were permitted to be promoted and employed.
translations.idiomatic: Capable Mongols and Central Asians were permitted to enter government service.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨廢疾者，存恤之。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, the disabled, and the infirm were to be preserved and succored.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, the childless, the disabled, and the infirm were to receive care and relief.

sentences.zh: 民年七十以上，一子復。

translations.literal: Common people aged seventy and above had one son exempted from service.
translations.idiomatic: For commoners aged seventy or more, one son was exempted from corvée and tax.

sentences.zh: 他利害當興革不在詔內者，有司具以聞。

translations.literal: Other benefits and harms that should be instituted or abolished and were not within the edict—the responsible offices were to report them fully.
translations.idiomatic: Any other reforms of benefit or harm not covered in the edict were to be reported in full by local officials.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸北京。

translations.literal: On renwu, the emperor visited the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he traveled to the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 改大都路曰北平府。

translations.literal: The Dadu circuit was changed to Beiping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He redesignated the Dadu circuit as Beiping prefecture.

sentences.zh: 征元故臣。

translations.literal: Former Yuan ministers were summoned.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned former Yuan officials to serve.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔徐達、常遇春取山西。

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict ordered Xu Da and Chang Yuchun to take Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he ordered Xu Da and Chang Yuchun to conquer Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，放元宮人。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Yuan palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he released the women of the Yuan palace.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，詔曰：「天下之治，天下之賢共理之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guihai, an edict said: 'The governance of the realm—the worthy of the realm govern it together.'
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guihai, he issued an edict: "The good order of the empire is achieved when the empire's worthies govern it together."

sentences.zh: 今賢士多隱岩穴，豈有司失於敦勸歟，朝廷疏於禮待歟，抑朕寡昧不足致賢，將在位者壅蔽使不上達歟？

translations.literal: Now worthy scholars mostly hide in mountain caves—is it that the offices have failed in earnest encouragement, that the court has been remiss in courteous treatment, or that We are dull and insufficient to attract the worthy, or that those in office obstruct and prevent them from reaching Us?
translations.idiomatic: Yet many men of talent now hide in seclusion. Is it that local officials have failed to encourage them earnestly, that the court has been remiss in honoring them, that I myself lack the virtue to draw them forth, or that those in power have blocked their path to me?

sentences.zh: 不然，賢士大夫，幼學壯行，豈甘沒世而已哉。

translations.literal: If not so, the worthy scholar-officials, studying in youth and acting in strength of years—how could they be willing to perish in obscurity and nothing more?
translations.idiomatic: Surely not—for men of learning and integrity, trained in youth and eager to act in their prime, cannot wish merely to die unknown.

sentences.zh: 天下甫定，朕願與諸儒講明治道。

translations.literal: The realm has just been settled; We wish to discuss and clarify the way of good government with the various Confucians.
translations.idiomatic: The empire is newly pacified, and I wish to discuss the principles of good government with scholars.

sentences.zh: 有能輔朕濟民者，有司禮遣。

translations.literal: Those able to assist Us and succor the people—the responsible offices are to send them with ritual courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever can aid me in bringing relief to the people, let officials escort him here with due ceremony.

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，常遇春下保定，遂下真定。

translations.literal: 'On yichou, Chang Yuchun took Baoding, then took Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: " On yichou Chang Yuchun captured Baoding and then Zhending.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，馮勝、湯和下懷慶，澤、潞相繼下。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on gengwu, Feng Sheng and Tang He took Huaiqing; Ze and Lu fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengwu, Feng Sheng and Tang He took Huaiqing, and Ze and Lu prefectures fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，至自北京。

translations.literal: On dingchou, he arrived from the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he returned from the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以元都平，詔天下。

translations.literal: On wuyin, because the Yuan capital was pacified, an edict was issued to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, with the Yuan capital pacified, he proclaimed the news throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，遣使分行天下，訪求賢才。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jihai, envoys were dispatched traveling separately through the realm to seek out worthy talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jihai, he sent envoys throughout the empire to seek out men of talent.

sentences.zh: 庚子，始祀上帝於圜丘。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Supreme Lord was first sacrificed to at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he performed the first sacrifice to the Supreme Lord at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔劉基還。

translations.literal: On guihai, Liu Ji was ordered to return.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he recalled Liu Ji to office.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，徐達克太原，擴廓帖木兒走甘肅，山西平。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingmao, Xu Da captured Taiyuan; Köke Temür fled to Gansu, and Shanxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingmao, Xu Da took Taiyuan; Köke Temür fled to Gansu, and Shanxi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 己巳，置登聞鼓。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Petition Drum was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he established the Petition Drum for direct appeals to the throne.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以書諭明昇。

translations.literal: On renchen, a letter instructed Ming Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he sent a letter of instruction to Ming Sheng.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙巳，立功臣廟於雞籠山。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, the first month, on yisi, a temple to meritorious officials was established on Jilong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on yisi of the first month of spring, he founded a temple to his meritorious ministers on Cock's Cage Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁未，享太廟。

translations.literal: On dingwei, offerings were made at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he offered sacrifice in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔曰：「朕淮右布衣，因天下亂，率眾渡江，保民圖治，今十有五年。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict said: 'We, a commoner of the Huai right, because the realm was in disorder, led the multitude across the river to protect the people and seek good government—now fifteen years.'
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he issued an edict: "I was a commoner of the Huai region. When the empire fell into chaos I led my followers across the Yangzi to protect the people and seek good government—now fifteen years have passed."

sentences.zh: 荷天眷祐，悉皆戡定。

translations.literal: Bearing Heaven's favor and blessing, all were pacified by force.
translations.idiomatic: By Heaven's favor all has been brought to order.

sentences.zh: 用是命將北征，齊魯之民饋糧給軍，不憚千里。

translations.literal: For this reason generals were ordered on the northern expedition; the people of Qi and Lu supplied grain to the army, not fearing a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I sent my generals north, and the people of Qi and Lu supplied the army with provisions, traveling a thousand li without complaint.

sentences.zh: 朕軫厥勞，已免元年田租。

translations.literal: We grieved their labor and already remitted the first year's land tax.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of their toil, I had already remitted the first year's land tax.

sentences.zh: 遭旱民未蘇，其更賜一年。

translations.literal: Drought was encountered and the people had not recovered; they were further granted one more year.
translations.idiomatic: Because drought had struck and the people had not yet recovered, I granted them another year's exemption.

sentences.zh: 頃者大軍平燕都，下晉、冀，民被兵燹，困征斂，北平、燕南、河東、山西今年田租亦與蠲免。

translations.literal: Recently the great army pacified Yan capital and took Jin and Ji; the people suffered from warfare and were distressed by levies—Beiping, Yannan, Hedong, and Shanxi land tax for this year is also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: When my armies recently pacified the Yan capital and subdued Jin and Ji, the people suffered war and crushing levies; land tax for this year in Beiping, southern Yan, Hedong, and Shanxi is likewise remitted.

sentences.zh: 河南諸郡歸附，久欲惠之，西北未平，師過其地，是以未遑。

translations.literal: The prefectures of Henan submitted; We long wished to show them favor, but the northwest was not yet pacified and armies passed through their lands, so there was no leisure.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures of Henan had long since submitted, and I had wished to show them favor, but the northwest was not yet pacified and my armies passed through on campaign, so I had no leisure to do so.

sentences.zh: 今晉、冀平矣，西抵潼關，北界大河，南至唐、鄧、光、息，今年稅糧悉除之。

translations.literal: Now Jin and Ji are pacified, west to Tong Pass, north to the Great River, south to Tang, Deng, Guang, and Xi—this year's tax grain is entirely abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Jin and Ji are pacified, from Tong Pass in the west to the Great River in the north and Tang, Deng, Guang, and Xi in the south, all tax grain for this year is abolished.

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「應天、太平、鎮江、宣城、廣德供億浩穰。

translations.literal: " Again an edict said: "Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Xuancheng, and Guangde supplied provisions in vast abundance.
translations.idiomatic: " He issued another edict: "Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Xuancheng, and Guangde have borne the heaviest burden of supply.

sentences.zh: 去歲蠲租，遇旱惠不及下。

translations.literal: Last year rent was remitted, but drought was encountered and favor did not reach below.
translations.idiomatic: Last year I remitted rent, but drought struck and the relief did not reach the lowest ranks.

sentences.zh: 其再免諸郡及無為州今年租稅。

translations.literal: These various prefectures and Wuzhou are again exempted from this year's rent and tax.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore remit this year's rent and tax again for those prefectures and for Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 」庚申，常遇春取大同。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Chang Yuchun took Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Chang Yuchun took Datong.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭寇山東濱海郡縣。

translations.literal: That month, Wo pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That month Japanese pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅朔，詔修元史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingyin, the first day of the month, an edict ordered compilation of the History of Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, bingyin, he ordered the compilation of the History of Yuan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On renwu, the ceremonial plowing field was tilled.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he performed the ceremonial plowing of the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，徐達至奉元，張思道遁。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengzi, Xu Da reached Fengyuan and Zhang Sidao fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengzi, Xu Da reached Fengyuan and Zhang Sidao fled.

sentences.zh: 振陝西饑，戶米三石。

translations.literal: Shaanxi famine was relieved with three shi of grain per household.
translations.idiomatic: He provided famine relief in Shaanxi at three shi of grain per household.

sentences.zh: 丙午，常遇春至鳳翔，李思齊奔臨洮。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Chang Yuchun reached Fengxiang; Li Siqi fled to Lintao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Chang Yuchun reached Fengxiang, and Li Siqi fled to Lintao.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，遇春還師北平。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingyin, Yuchun returned the army to Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingyin, Yuchun brought the army back to Beiping.

sentences.zh: 己巳，諸王子受經於博士孔克仁。

translations.literal: On jisi, the various princes received the classics from the erudite Kong Keren.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the imperial princes began studying the classics under the erudite Kong Keren.

sentences.zh: 令功臣子弟入學。

translations.literal: The sons of meritorious officials were ordered to enter the schools.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the sons of meritorious officials to enter the schools.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，編《祖訓錄》，定封建諸王之制。

translations.literal: On yihai, the Records of Ancestral Instruction was compiled and the system of enfeoffing feudal princes was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he compiled the Records of Ancestral Instruction and established the system of enfeoffing imperial princes.

sentences.zh: 徐達下鞏昌。

translations.literal: Xu Da took Gongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da took Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賜秦、隴新附州縣稅糧。

translations.literal: On bingzi, tax grain was granted to newly submitted prefectures and counties of Qin and Long.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he granted tax grain to newly submitted prefectures and counties in Qin and Long.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，馮勝至臨洮，李思齊降。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Feng Sheng reached Lintao and Li Siqi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Feng Sheng reached Lintao and Li Siqi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，徐達襲破元豫王於西寧。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Xu Da raided and defeated the Yuan Prince of Yu at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Xu Da raided and defeated the Yuan Prince of Yu at Xining.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiawu, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, jiawu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，徐達下平涼、延安。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Xu Da took Pingliang and Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Xu Da took Pingliang and Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 張良臣以慶陽降，尋叛。

translations.literal: Zhang Liangchen surrendered with Qingyang, then soon rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Liangchen surrendered at Qingyang, then soon rebelled.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，始祀地於方丘。

translations.literal: On guimao, Earth was first sacrificed to at the Square Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he performed the first sacrifice to Earth at the Square Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，常遇春克開平，元帝北走。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jimao, Chang Yuchun captured Kaiping and the Yuan emperor fled north.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao, Chang Yuchun captured Kaiping and the Yuan emperor fled north.

sentences.zh: 壬午，封陳日煃為安南國王。

translations.literal: On renwu, Chen Rijiong was enfeoffed as king of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Chen Rijiong was enfeoffed as king of Annan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，鄂國公常遇春卒於軍，詔李文忠領其眾。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jihai, Duke of E Guo Chang Yuchun died in the army; Li Wenzhong was ordered to command his forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jihai, Chang Yuchun, Duke of E, died on campaign; Li Wenzhong was ordered to take command of his forces.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，擴廓帖木兒遣將破原州、涇州。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Köke Temür dispatched generals who captured Yuanzhou and Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Köke Temür sent generals who recaptured Yuanzhou and Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，馮勝擊走之。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Feng Sheng attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Feng Sheng attacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，明昇遣使來。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Ming Sheng sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Ming Sheng sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，元兵攻大同，李文忠擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingyin, Yuan troops attacked Datong; Li Wenzhong defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingyin, Yuan troops attacked Datong and Li Wenzhong defeated them.

sentences.zh: 己巳，定內侍官制。

translations.literal: On jisi, the eunuch official system was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he established the eunuch bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 諭吏部曰：「內臣但備使令，毋多人，古來若輩擅權，可為鑒戒。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel was instructed: "Inner attendants are only to supply errands; do not employ many. Throughout antiquity such persons seized power—let this be a warning.
translations.idiomatic: He instructed the Ministry of Personnel: "Palace eunuchs are only to run errands; do not employ too many. Throughout history such men have seized power—let that be your warning.

sentences.zh: 馭之之道，當使之畏法，勿令有功，有功則驕恣矣。

translations.literal: The way to control them is to make them fear the law; do not let them achieve merit, for with merit they grow arrogant and unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: Control them by making them fear the law; do not let them earn merit, for merit breeds arrogance and license.

sentences.zh: 」癸酉，《元史》成。

translations.literal: " On guiyou, the History of Yuan was completed.
translations.idiomatic: " On guiyou the History of Yuan was completed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，封王顓為高麗國王。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Wang Zhuan was enfeoffed as king of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Wang Zhuan was enfeoffed as king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸未，徐達克慶陽，斬張良臣，陝西平。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Xu Da captured Qingyang, executed Zhang Liangchen, and Shaanxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Xu Da captured Qingyang, executed Zhang Liangchen, and pacified Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，命儒臣纂禮書。

translations.literal: That month, Confucian officials were ordered to compile ritual books.
translations.idiomatic: That month he ordered scholar-officials to compile books of ritual.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，召徐達、湯和還，馮勝留總軍事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinchou, Xu Da and Tang He were recalled; Feng Sheng remained to command the armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinchou, Xu Da and Tang He were recalled while Feng Sheng remained in overall command.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以臨濠為中都。

translations.literal: On guimao, Linhuang was made Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he made Linhuang the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，征南師還。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the southern campaign army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the southern campaign army returned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，遣楊璟諭明昇。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on renxu, Yang Jing was dispatched to instruct Ming Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renxu, Yang Jing was sent to instruct Ming Sheng.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，甘露降於鐘山，群臣請告廟，不許。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, sweet dew fell on Bell Mountain; the officials requested announcement at the temple, but it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu sweet dew fell on Bell Mountain; the officials asked to report it at the ancestral temple, but he refused.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔天下郡縣立學。

translations.literal: On xinmao, an edict ordered schools established in every prefecture and county throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he ordered schools established in every prefecture and county in the empire.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣使貽元帝書。

translations.literal: That month, envoys were dispatched bearing a letter to the Yuan emperor.
translations.idiomatic: That month he sent envoys bearing a letter to the Yuan emperor.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，祀上帝於圜丘，以仁祖配。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yisi, the Supreme Lord was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound, with Renzu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yisi, he sacrificed to the Supreme Lord at the Circular Mound, with Renzu as associate.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，封阿答阿者為占城國王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, A Daazhe was enfeoffed as king of Champa.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, A Daazhe was enfeoffed as king of Champa.

sentences.zh: 甲申，振西安諸府饑，戶米二石。

translations.literal: On jiashen, famine in the prefectures of Xi'an was relieved with two shi of grain per household.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he provided famine relief in the Xi'an prefectures at two shi of grain per household.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大賚平定中原及征南將士。

translations.literal: On jichou, great rewards were bestowed on those who pacified the central plains and the southern campaign generals.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he bestowed great rewards on those who had pacified the central plains and on the southern campaign generals.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，擴廓帖木兒攻蘭州，指揮於光死之。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Köke Temür attacked Lanzhou; Commander Yu Guang died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Köke Temür attacked Lanzhou, and Commander Yu Guang died defending it.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、安南、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Annan, and Goryeo sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Champa, Annan, and Goryeo sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸巳，徐達為征虜大將軍，李文忠、馮勝、鄧愈、湯和副之，分道北征。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, the first month, on guisi, Xu Da became great general for the campaign against the barbarians, with Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He as deputies, campaigning north by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on guisi of the first month of spring, Xu Da was appointed great general for the northern campaign, with Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He as his deputies, to advance north by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，追封郭子興滁陽王。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guiwei, Guo Zixing was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chuyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiwei, Guo Zixing was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chuyang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔求賢才可任六部者。

translations.literal: On wuzi, an edict sought worthy talent fit to hold the Six Ministries.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he issued an edict seeking men of talent fit for the Six Ministries.

sentences.zh: 是月，李文忠下興和，進兵察罕腦兒，執元平章竹貞。

translations.literal: That month, Li Wenzhong took Xinghe and advanced to Chaghan-nur, capturing the Yuan pingzhang Zhuzhen.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Wenzhong took Xinghe, advanced to Chaghan-nur, and captured the Yuan minister Zhuzhen.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，免南畿、河南、山東、北平、浙東、江西廣信、饒州今年田租。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengyin, land rent was remitted for this year in the southern capital region, Henan, Shandong, Beiping, eastern Zhe, Jiangxi Guangxin, and Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, he remitted this year's land rent in the southern capital region, Henan, Shandong, Beiping, eastern Zhe, Jiangxi Guangxin, and Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，封皇子樉為秦王，棡晉王，棣燕王，橚吳王，楨楚王，榑齊王，梓潭王，杞趙王，檀魯王，從孫守謙靖江王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yichou, the princes Shu was enfeoffed as King of Qin, Gang as Jin, Di as Yan, Chu as Wu, Zhen as Chu, Gui as Qi, Zi as Tan, Qi as Zhao, Tan as Lu, and the collateral descendant Shouqian as Prince of Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yichou, he enfeoffed his sons: Shu as King of Qin, Gang as Jin, Di as Yan, Chu as Wu, Zhen as Chu, Gui as Qi, Zi as Tan, Qi as Zhao, Tan as Lu, and his collateral descendant Shouqian as Prince of Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 徐達大破擴廓帖木兒於沈兒峪，盡降其眾，擴廓走和林。

translations.literal: Xu Da greatly defeated Köke Temür at Shen'er Valley; all his forces surrendered; Köke fled to Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: At Shen'er Valley Xu Da routed Köke Temür, accepted the surrender of his entire force, and Köke fled to Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，元帝崩於應昌，子愛猷識理達臘嗣。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Yuan emperor died at Yingchang; his son Ayushiridara succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the Yuan emperor died at Yingchang, and his son Ayushiridara succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 是月，慈利土官覃垕作亂。

translations.literal: That month, the Cili native official Tan Hao rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tan Hao, a native official of Cili, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，徐達取興元。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jichou, Xu Da took Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jichou, Xu Da took Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 分遣鄧愈招諭吐蕃。

translations.literal: Deng Yu was separately dispatched to summon and instruct the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Yu was separately dispatched to summon and win over the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔守令舉學識篤行之士。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict ordered prefects and magistrates to recommend scholars of solid learning and conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he ordered prefects and magistrates to recommend scholars of solid learning and upright conduct.

sentences.zh: 己亥，設科取士。

translations.literal: On jihai, the civil service examination was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he established the civil service examination.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李文忠克應昌。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Li Wenzhong captured Yingchang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Wenzhong captured Yingchang.

sentences.zh: 元嗣君北走，獲其子買的裏八剌，降五萬餘人，窮追至北慶州，不及而還。

translations.literal: The Yuan heir fled north; his son Maidiliba was captured; more than fifty thousand surrendered; pursuit was pressed to Beiqingzhou but did not overtake and they returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan heir fled north; his son Maidiliba was captured and more than fifty thousand men surrendered; the pursuers pressed on to Beiqingzhou but could not overtake him and turned back.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔行大射禮。

translations.literal: On dingwei, an edict ordered the great archery rite performed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he ordered the great archery rite performed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祀地於方丘，以仁祖配。

translations.literal: On wushen, Earth was sacrificed to at the Square Mound, with Renzu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he sacrificed to Earth at the Square Mound, with Renzu as associate.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，徐達下興元。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Xu Da took Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Xu Da took Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 鄧愈克河州。

translations.literal: Deng Yu captured Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Yu captured Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔開國時將帥無嗣者祿其家。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an edict ordered that where founding generals had no heirs, their families were to receive stipends.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he ordered stipends for the families of founding generals who left no heirs.

sentences.zh: 是月旱，齋戒，後妃親執爨，皇太子諸王饋於齋所。

translations.literal: That month there was drought; fasting and purification were observed; empresses and consorts personally cooked; the crown prince and princes presented food at the fasting hall.
translations.idiomatic: That month, during drought, he observed fasting and purification; empresses and consorts cooked in person, and the crown prince and princes brought food to the fasting hall.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午朔，素服草屨，步禱山川壇，露宿凡三日，還齋於西廡。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuwu, the first day of the month, in plain dress and straw sandals he walked to pray at the mountain and river altars, sleeping in the open for three days in all, then returned to fast in the western gallery.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, wuwu, dressed plainly in straw sandals he walked to pray at the altars of mountains and rivers, sleeping in the open for three days before returning to fast in the western gallery.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賚將士，省獄囚，命有司訪求通經術明治道者。

translations.literal: On xinyou, soldiers were rewarded, prison inmates were reviewed, and responsible offices were ordered to seek out those versed in the classics and skilled in governing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he rewarded the troops, reviewed prisoners, and ordered officials to seek men versed in the classics and skilled in governance.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大雨。

translations.literal: On renxu, heavy rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 壬申，李文忠捷奏至，命仕元者勿賀。

translations.literal: On renshen, Li Wenzhong's victory report arrived; those who had served the Yuan were ordered not to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Li Wenzhong's victory report arrived, and he ordered former Yuan officials not to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 諡元主曰順帝。

translations.literal: The Yuan ruler was given the posthumous title Emperor Shun.
translations.idiomatic: He gave the Yuan ruler the posthumous title Emperor Shun.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，買的裏八剌至京師，群臣請獻俘。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Maidiliba reached the capital; the officials requested presentation of captives.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Maidiliba reached the capital, and the officials asked to present him as a captive.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「武王伐殷用之乎？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "When King Wu attacked Yin, did he use this?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "When King Wu attacked the Yin, did he do this?"

sentences.zh: 」省臣以唐太宗嘗行之對。

translations.literal: The Secretariat officials answered that Emperor Taizong of Tang had once done so.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat officials replied that Emperor Taizong of Tang had once done so.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「太宗是待王世充耳。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Taizong was dealing with Wang Shichong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Taizong was dealing with Wang Shichong.

sentences.zh: 若遇隋之子孫，恐不爾也。

translations.literal: Had he encountered a descendant of Sui, I fear he would not have done so.
translations.idiomatic: Had he met a descendant of the Sui, I doubt he would have done the same.

sentences.zh: 」遂不許。

translations.literal: " He thereupon did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: " He thereupon refused.

sentences.zh: 又以捷奏多侈辭，謂宰相曰：「元主中國百年，朕與卿等父母皆賴其生養，奈何為此浮薄之言？

translations.literal: Also, because the victory report contained much inflated language, he told the chief ministers: "The Yuan ruler held China for a hundred years; I and you, ministers, our parents all relied on him for nurture—how can you write such frivolous words?"
translations.idiomatic: Finding the victory report full of inflated language, he told his chief ministers, "The Yuan ruled China for a century; you and I, and our parents before us, all lived under their nurture—how can you write such frivolous words?"

sentences.zh: 亟改之。

translations.literal: Change it quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Change it at once.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，封買的裏八剌為崇禮侯。

translations.literal: On yihai, Maidiliba was enfeoffed as Marquis of Chongli.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he enfeoffed Maidiliba as Marquis of Chongli.

sentences.zh: 丙子，告捷於南郊。

translations.literal: On bingzi, victory was announced at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he announced victory at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，告太廟，詔示天下。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Grand Temple was notified and an edict was proclaimed to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he reported to the Grand Temple and issued an edict to the entire empire.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，徙蘇州、松江、嘉興、湖州、杭州民無業者田臨濠，給資糧牛種，復三年。

translations.literal: On xinsi, people without occupations from Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Hangzhou were relocated to farm fields at Linhuang, given provisions, grain, cattle, and seed, with exemption for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he relocated unemployed people from Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Hangzhou to farm at Linhuang, providing provisions, grain, cattle, and seed, with a three-year tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭寇山東、浙江、福建濱海州縣。

translations.literal: That month, Wo pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties of Shandong, Zhejiang, and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: That month Japanese pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties in Shandong, Zhejiang, and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，明昇將吳友仁寇漢中，參政傅友德擊卻之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on bingchen, Ming Sheng's general Wu Youren attacked Hanzhong; Administrator Fu Youde repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, Ming Sheng's general Wu Youren attacked Hanzhong, and Administrator Fu Youde repelled him.

sentences.zh: 中書左丞楊憲有罪誅。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Yang Xian was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xian, left vice director of the Secretariat, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，遣使瘞中原遺骸。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiyou, envoys were dispatched to bury the scattered bones of the central plains.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou, he sent envoys to bury the scattered bones of the central plains.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，詔儒士更直午門，為武臣講經史。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on bingchen, Confucian scholars were ordered on rotating duty at the Meridian Gate to lecture military officials in the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingchen, he ordered Confucian scholars on rotating duty at the Meridian Gate to lecture military officials in the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，周德興為征南將軍，討覃垕，垕遁。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zhou Dexing became southern campaign general to suppress Tan Hao; Hao fled.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhou Dexing was appointed southern campaign general to suppress Tan Hao, who fled.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，貽元嗣君書。

translations.literal: On xinsi, a letter was sent to the Yuan heir.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he sent a letter to the Yuan heir.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，北征師還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen, the northern campaign army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renchen, the northern campaign army returned.

sentences.zh: 甲午，告武成於郊廟。

translations.literal: On jiawu, martial accomplishment was announced at the suburban temples.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he announced martial accomplishment at the suburban temples.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大封功臣。

translations.literal: On bingshen, meritorious officials were greatly enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he enfeoffed his meritorious officials on a grand scale.

sentences.zh: 進李善長韓國公，徐達魏國公，封李文忠曹國公，馮勝宋國公，鄧愈衛國公，常遇春子茂鄭國公，湯和等侯者二十八人。

translations.literal: Li Shanchang was advanced to Duke of Han, Xu Da to Duke of Wei; Li Wenzhong was enfeoffed Duke of Cao, Feng Sheng Duke of Song, Deng Yu Duke of Wei, Chang Yuchun's son Mao Duke of Zheng, and Tang He and twenty-eight others as marquises.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shanchang was advanced to Duke of Han and Xu Da to Duke of Wei; Li Wenzhong was made Duke of Cao, Feng Sheng Duke of Song, Deng Yu Duke of Wei, Chang Yuchun's son Mao Duke of Zheng, and Tang He and twenty-eight others were made marquises.

sentences.zh: 己亥，設壇親祭戰沒將士。

translations.literal: On jihai, an altar was set up and fallen campaign generals were personally sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he set up an altar and personally sacrificed to the generals who had died in battle.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: On gengxu, rites were performed at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he performed rites at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔戶部置戶籍、戶帖，歲計登耗以聞，著為令。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to establish household registers and household placards; annual accounts of surplus and deficit were to be reported, established as regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he ordered the Ministry of Revenue to establish household registers and placards, with annual reports of surplus and deficit, and made this a standing regulation.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，封中書右丞汪廣洋忠勤伯，御史中丞劉基誠意伯。

translations.literal: On yimao, Right Vice Director Wang Guangyang was enfeoffed as Earl of Loyal Diligence, and Vice Censor-in-chief Liu Ji as Earl of Sincere Intent.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Wang Guangyang, right vice director of the Secretariat, was enfeoffed as Earl of Loyal Diligence, and Liu Ji, vice censor-in-chief, as Earl of Sincere Intent.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，復貽元嗣君書，並諭和林諸部。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guihai, a letter was again sent to the Yuan heir, also instructing the various tribes of Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guihai, he again sent a letter to the Yuan heir and instructed the tribes of Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 甲子，建奉先殿。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Hall for Veneration of Ancestors was built.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he built the Hall for Veneration of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣使祭歷代帝王陵寢，並加修葺。

translations.literal: On gengwu, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the tombs of emperors of successive dynasties, which were also repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he sent envoys to sacrifice at the tombs of emperors of successive dynasties and ordered repairs to them.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜勳臣田。

translations.literal: On jimao, fields were granted to meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he granted fields to meritorious officials.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以正月至是月，日中屢有黑子，詔廷臣言得失。

translations.literal: On renwu, from the first month to this month black spots repeatedly appeared on the sun at midday; court officials were ordered to speak of gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, from the first month to this month black spots had repeatedly appeared on the sun at midday, and he ordered court officials to speak frankly of the empire's gains and losses.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、爪哇、西洋入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Java, and the Western Ocean sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Champa, Java, and the Western Ocean sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙戌，李善長罷，汪廣洋為右丞相。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, the first month, on bingxu, Li Shanchang was dismissed and Wang Guangyang became right chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on bingxu of the first month of spring, Li Shanchang was dismissed and Wang Guangyang became right chief minister.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，中山侯湯和為征西將軍，江夏侯周德興、德慶侯廖永忠副之，率舟師由瞿塘，潁川侯傅友德為征虜前將軍，濟甯侯顧時副之，率步騎由秦隴伐蜀。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Zhongshan Marquis Tang He became western campaign general, with Jiangxia Marquis Zhou Dexing and Deqing Marquis Liao Yongzhong as deputies, leading the fleet through Qutang; Yingchuan Marquis Fu Youde became front general for the campaign against the barbarians, with Jining Marquis Gu Shi as deputy, leading infantry and cavalry through Qin and Long to attack Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Tang He, Marquis of Zhongshan, was made western campaign general with Zhou Dexing, Marquis of Jiangxia, and Liao Yongzhong, Marquis of Deqing, as his deputies, to lead the fleet through Qutang; Fu Youde, Marquis of Yingchuan, was made front general for the barbarian campaign with Gu Shi, Marquis of Jining, as deputy, to lead infantry and cavalry through Qin and Long against Shu.

sentences.zh: 魏國公徐達練兵北平。

translations.literal: Duke of Wei Xu Da drilled troops at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da, Duke of Wei, drilled troops at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 戊子，衛國公鄧愈督餉給征蜀軍。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Duke of Wei Deng Yu supervised provisions for the Shu campaign army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Deng Yu, Duke of Wei, supervised provisions for the Shu campaign army.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，建郊廟於中都。

translations.literal: On gengyin, suburban temples were built at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he built suburban temples at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔設科取士，連舉三年，嗣後三年一舉。

translations.literal: On dingwei, an edict established the civil examination, to be held three years in succession, and thereafter once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he established the civil examination, to be held three years in succession and thereafter once every three years.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免山西旱災田租。

translations.literal: On wushen, Shanxi drought disaster land rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he remitted land rent in Shanxi stricken by drought.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，幸中都。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiaxu, the emperor visited the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiaxu, he visited the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至自中都。

translations.literal: On renwu, he arrived from the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he returned from the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 元平章劉益以遼東降。

translations.literal: The Yuan pingzhang Liu Yi surrendered with Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan minister Liu Yi surrendered with Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲太平、鎮江、甯國田租。

translations.literal: That month, land rent was remitted in Taiping, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: That month he remitted land rent in Taiping, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉朔，始策試天下貢士，賜吳伯宗等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yiyou, the first day of the month, the palace examination of tribute scholars throughout the realm began; Wu Bozong and others were granted jinshi with rank of first or lower degrees in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, yiyou, he held the palace examination for tribute scholars from across the empire and granted Wu Bozong and others the jinshi degree and lower ranks in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，徙山後民萬七千戶屯北平。

translations.literal: On yisi, seventeen thousand households of people from beyond the mountains were relocated to garrison Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he relocated seventeen thousand households from beyond the mountains to garrison Beiping.

sentences.zh: 丁未，誠意伯劉基致仕。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Earl of Sincere Intent Liu Ji retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Liu Ji, Earl of Sincere Intent, retired from office.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，傅友德克階州，文、隆、綿三州相繼下。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingxu, Fu Youde captured Jiezhou; Wen, Long, and Mian prefectures fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingxu, Fu Youde captured Jiezhou, and Wen, Long, and Mian prefectures fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 五月，免江西、浙江秋糧。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, autumn grain tax was remitted in Jiangxi and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he remitted autumn grain tax in Jiangxi and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，傅友德克漢州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renwu, Fu Youde captured Hanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renwu, Fu Youde captured Hanzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，廖永忠克夔州。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Liao Yongzhong captured Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Liao Yongzhong captured Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，明昇將丁世貞破文州，守將硃顯忠死之。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Ming Sheng's general Ding Shizhen captured Wenzhou; the defending general Zhu Xianzhong died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Ming Sheng's general Ding Shizhen took Wenzhou, and the defending general Zhu Xianzhong died in the defense.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，湯和至重慶，明昇降。

translations.literal: On guimao, Tang He reached Chongqing and Ming Sheng surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Tang He reached Chongqing and Ming Sheng surrendered.

sentences.zh: 戊申，倭寇膠州。

translations.literal: On wushen, Wo pirates raided Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Japanese pirates raided Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，徙山後民三萬五千戶於內地，又徙沙漠遺民三萬二千戶屯田北平。

translations.literal: That month, thirty-five thousand households of people from beyond the mountains were relocated to the interior, and another thirty-two thousand desert remnant people were relocated to farm at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: That month he relocated thirty-five thousand households from beyond the mountains to the interior, and another thirty-two thousand desert remnant people to farm at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，徐達練兵山西。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinhai, Xu Da drilled troops in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinhai, Xu Da drilled troops in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，傅友德下成都，四川平。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Fu Youde took Chengdu and Sichuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Fu Youde took Chengdu and pacified Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，明昇至京師，封歸義侯。

translations.literal: On yichou, Ming Sheng reached the capital and was enfeoffed Marquis of Returning to Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Ming Sheng reached the capital and was enfeoffed Marquis of Returning to Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，免中都、淮、揚及泰、滁、無為田租。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiawu, land rent was remitted in the Central Capital, Huai, Yang, and Tai, Chu, and Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiawu, he remitted land rent in the Central Capital, Huai, Yang, Tai, Chu, and Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，振陝西饑。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Shaanxi famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he provided famine relief in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，高州海寇亂，通判王名善死之。

translations.literal: That month, sea bandits rebelled in Gaozhou; Assistant Prefect Wang Mingshan died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: That month sea bandits rebelled in Gaozhou, and Assistant Prefect Wang Mingshan died defending the city.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengxu, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, gengxu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，征蜀師還。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on bingshen, the Shu campaign army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingshen, the Shu campaign army returned.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, rites were performed at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, he performed rites at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命官吏犯贓者罪勿貸。

translations.literal: On gengshen, officials guilty of corruption were ordered not to be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he ordered that officials guilty of corruption were not to be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 是月，免陝西、河南被災田租。

translations.literal: That month, disaster-stricken land rent was remitted in Shaanxi and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: That month he remitted disaster-stricken land rent in Shaanxi and Henan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，徐達還。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xu Da returned.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、浡泥、高麗、三佛齊、暹羅、日本、真臘入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annan, Poni, Goryeo, Sanfoqi, Siam, Japan, and Zhenla sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annan, Poni, Goryeo, Sanfoqi, Siam, Japan, and Zhenla sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸丑，待制王禕使雲南，詔諭元梁王把匝剌瓦爾密。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, the first month, on guichou, Academician Wang Wei was sent to Yunnan with an edict instructing the Yuan Prince of Liang Bazalawarmi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on guichou of the first month of spring, Academician Wang Wei was sent to Yunnan with an edict instructing the Yuan Prince of Liang, Bazalawarmi.

sentences.zh: 禕至，不屈死。

translations.literal: When Wei arrived, he would not submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei arrived, the prince refused to submit and Wei was put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，徙陳理、明升於高麗。

translations.literal: On yichou, Chen Li and Ming Sheng were relocated to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Chen Li and Ming Sheng were relocated to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，魏國公徐達為征虜大將軍，出雁門，趨和林，曹國公李文忠為左副將軍，出應昌，宋國公馮勝為征西將軍，取甘肅，征擴廓帖木兒。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Duke of Wei Xu Da became great general for the campaign against the barbarians, exiting Yanmen and hastening to Karakorum; Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong became left deputy general, exiting Yingchang; Duke of Song Feng Sheng became western campaign general to take Gansu and campaign against Köke Temür.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Xu Da, Duke of Wei, was made great general for the northern campaign, to exit Yanmen and advance on Karakorum; Li Wenzhong, Duke of Cao, was made left deputy general to exit Yingchang; Feng Sheng, Duke of Song, was made western campaign general to take Gansu and campaign against Köke Temür.

sentences.zh: 靖海侯吳禎督海運，餉遼東。

translations.literal: Marquis of Pacifying the Sea Wu Zhen supervised sea transport to provision Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhen, Marquis of Pacifying the Sea, supervised sea transport to provision Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 衛國公鄧愈為征南將軍，江夏侯周德興、江陰侯吳良副之，分道討湖南、廣西洞蠻。

translations.literal: Duke of Wei Deng Yu became southern campaign general, with Jiangxia Marquis Zhou Dexing and Jiangyin Marquis Wu Liang as deputies, campaigning by separate routes against the cave barbarians of Hunan and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Yu, Duke of Wei, was made southern campaign general with Zhou Dexing, Marquis of Jiangxia, and Wu Liang, Marquis of Jiangyin, as deputies, to campaign by separate routes against the cave barbarians of Hunan and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，安南陳叔明弒其主日熞自立，遣使入貢，卻之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingxu, Chen Shuming of Annan murdered his lord Rijie and established himself, sending envoys with tribute; they were declined.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingxu, Chen Shuming of Annan murdered his lord Rijie and seized the throne, sending envoys with tribute; the emperor refused them.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，都督僉事藍玉敗擴廓於土剌河。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingmao, Regional Commander Lan Yu defeated Köke at the Tula River.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingmao, Regional Commander Lan Yu defeated Köke at the Tula River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，振濟南、萊州饑。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jimao, Jinan and Laizhou famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jimao, he provided famine relief in Jinan and Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，始行鄉飲酒禮。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the village drinking ceremony was first performed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he first performed the village drinking ceremony.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈平散毛諸洞蠻。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Deng Yu pacified the Sanmao and various cave barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Deng Yu pacified the Sanmao and various cave barbarians.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，徐達及元兵戰於嶺北，敗績。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renzi, Xu Da fought Yuan troops north of the mountains and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renzi, Xu Da fought Yuan troops north of the mountains and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔曰：「天下大定，禮儀風俗不可不正。

translations.literal: That month, an edict said: "The realm is greatly settled; ritual and custom must be rectified.
translations.idiomatic: That month he issued an edict: "The empire is now largely at peace, and ritual and custom must be set right.

sentences.zh: 諸遭亂為人奴隸者復為民。

translations.literal: Those who in the disorder became others' slaves are restored as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Those who in the turmoil became others' slaves shall be restored as free commoners.

sentences.zh: 凍餒者里中富室假貸之，孤寡殘疾者官養之，毋失所。

translations.literal: Those frozen and starving are to be loaned to by wealthy households in the lane; orphans, widows, and the disabled are to be supported by the government, that none be left without refuge.
translations.idiomatic: Those suffering cold and hunger shall be loaned to by wealthy households in their communities; orphans, widows, and the disabled shall be supported by the government so that none lack a home.

sentences.zh: 鄉黨論齒，相見揖拜，毋違禮。

translations.literal: In the village age is discussed; on meeting, bow and salute—do not violate ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Villages shall honor age in their dealings, and on meeting shall bow and salute without violating proper ritual.

sentences.zh: 婚姻毋論財。

translations.literal: In marriage, do not discuss wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Marriage arrangements shall not be made on the basis of wealth.

sentences.zh: 喪事稱家有無，毋惑陰陽拘忌，停柩暴露。

translations.literal: In funerals, expenditure should match the family's means; do not be deluded by yin-yang taboos and leave the coffin exposed.
translations.idiomatic: Funerals shall be conducted according to the family's means, without being bound by yin-yang taboos that leave coffins exposed.

sentences.zh: 流民復業者各就丁力耕種，毋以舊田為限。

translations.literal: Wandering people who return to their occupations shall each cultivate according to their labor capacity, without being limited by former fields.
translations.idiomatic: Returned refugees shall each farm according to their labor capacity, without being limited to their former holdings.

sentences.zh: 僧道齋醮雜男女，恣飲食，有司嚴治之。

translations.literal: Buddhist and Daoist fasting assemblies mixing men and women and indulging in food and drink—the responsible offices are to punish this strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist and Daoist assemblies that mix men and women and indulge in feasting shall be strictly punished by local officials.

sentences.zh: 閩、粵豪家毋閹人子為火者，犯者抵罪。

translations.literal: Powerful families of Fujian and Guangdong must not castrate sons to serve as fire-keepers; violators are guilty of crime.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful families of Fujian and Guangdong must not castrate sons to serve as fire-keepers; violators shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 」六月丙子，定宦官禁令。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month, on bingzi, eunuch prohibitions were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month, on bingzi, he fixed prohibitions governing eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，定宮官女職之制。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the system of palace women's offices was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he fixed the system of palace women's offices.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，馮勝克甘肅，追敗元兵於瓜、沙州。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Feng Sheng captured Gansu and pursued and defeated Yuan troops at Guazhou and Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Feng Sheng captured Gansu and pursued and defeated Yuan troops at Guazhou and Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，定六部職掌及歲終考績法。

translations.literal: On guisi, the duties of the Six Ministries and the year-end performance review law were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he fixed the duties of the Six Ministries and the law for year-end performance review.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，吳良平靖州蠻。

translations.literal: On renyin, Wu Liang pacified the Jingzhou barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wu Liang pacified the Jingzhou barbarians.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李文忠敗元兵於阿魯渾河，宣甯侯曹良臣戰沒。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan troops at the Aruhun River; Marquis of Xuanning Cao Liangchen died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan troops at the Aruhun River; Cao Liangchen, Marquis of Xuanning, died in battle.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，作鐵榜誡功臣。

translations.literal: On yisi, an iron tablet admonishing meritorious officials was made.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he cast an iron tablet admonishing the meritorious officials.

sentences.zh: 是月，振山東饑，免被災郡縣田租。

translations.literal: That month, Shandong famine was relieved and disaster-stricken prefectures and counties had land rent remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month he provided famine relief in Shandong and remitted land rent in disaster-stricken prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，湯和及元兵戰於斷頭山，敗績。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on bingchen, Tang He fought Yuan troops at Broken Head Mountain and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, Tang He fought Yuan troops at Broken Head Mountain and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，吳良平五開、古州諸蠻。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingshen, Wu Liang pacified the Wukai and Guzhou barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingshen, Wu Liang pacified the Wukai and Guzhou barbarians.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，元兵犯雲內，同知黃里死之。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Yuan troops invaded Yunnei; Vice Director Huang Li died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yuan troops invaded Yunnei, and Vice Director Huang Li died defending it.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，周德興平婪鳳、安田諸蠻。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuwu, Zhou Dexing pacified the Lanfeng and Antian barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuwu, Zhou Dexing pacified the Lanfeng and Antian barbarians.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，馮勝師還。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on dingyou, Feng Sheng's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou, Feng Sheng's army returned.

sentences.zh: 是月，免應天、太平、鎮江、甯國、廣德田租。

translations.literal: That month, land rent was remitted in Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde.
translations.idiomatic: That month he remitted land rent in Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinyou, rites were performed at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinyou, he performed rites at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 甲子，征南師還。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the southern campaign army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the southern campaign army returned.

sentences.zh: 壬申，納哈出犯遼東。

translations.literal: On renshen, Naghachu invaded Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Naghachu invaded Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 是月，召徐達、李文忠還。

translations.literal: That month, Xu Da and Li Wenzhong were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xu Da and Li Wenzhong were recalled.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，詔以農桑學校課有司。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, an edict ordered responsible offices assessed on agriculture, sericulture, and schools.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, he ordered officials assessed on agriculture, sericulture, and schools.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命百官奏事啟皇太子。

translations.literal: On xinsi, all officials presenting memorials were ordered to inform the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he ordered all officials presenting memorials to inform the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈為征西將軍，征吐番。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Deng Yu became western campaign general to campaign against the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Deng Yu was made western campaign general to campaign against the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，貽元嗣君書。

translations.literal: On renyin, a letter was sent to the Yuan heir.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he sent a letter to the Yuan heir.

sentences.zh: 是年，瑣里、占城、高麗、琉球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Suoli, Champa, Goryeo, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Suoli, Champa, Goryeo, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 高麗貢使再至，諭自後三年一貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo tribute envoys came again; they were instructed that henceforth tribute would be once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: When Goryeo tribute envoys came again, he instructed them that henceforth tribute would be sent once every three years.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月甲寅，謫汪廣洋為廣東參政。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, the first month, on jiayin, Wang Guangyang was demoted to Administrator of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on jiayin of the first month of spring, Wang Guangyang was demoted to administrator of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，諭暫罷科舉，察舉賢才。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yiwei, an edict temporarily suspended the civil examination and ordered investigation and recommendation of worthy talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei, he temporarily suspended the civil examination and ordered investigation and recommendation of worthy talent.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命御史及按察使考察有司。

translations.literal: On renyin, censors and surveillance commissioners were ordered to investigate local officials.
