translations.idiomatic: On renyin he ordered censors and surveillance commissioners to investigate local officials.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guimao, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, guimao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 頒《昭鑒錄》，訓誡諸王。

translations.literal: The Records for Reflection was promulgated, admonishing the various princes.
translations.idiomatic: He promulgated the Records for Reflection to admonish the imperial princes.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太閱。

translations.literal: On wushen, a grand military review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he held a grand military review.

sentences.zh: 壬子，徐達為征虜大將軍，李文忠、馮勝、鄧愈、湯和副之，備邊山西、北平。

translations.literal: On renzi, Xu Da became great general for the campaign against the barbarians, with Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He as deputies, guarding the borders of Shanxi and Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Xu Da was made great general for the northern campaign, with Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He as his deputies, to guard the borders of Shanxi and Beiping.

sentences.zh: 甲子，指揮使於顯為總兵官，備倭。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Commander Yu Xian became overall military officer to guard against Wo.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Commander Yu Xian was appointed overall military officer to guard against Japanese pirates.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，令有司上山川險易圖。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jichou, responsible offices were ordered to submit maps of mountains and rivers, difficult and easy terrain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jichou, he ordered local officials to submit maps of terrain and waterways.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，盱眙獻瑞麥，薦宗廟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renwu, Xuyi presented auspicious wheat, which was offered at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renwu, Xuyi presented auspicious wheat, which was offered at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，擴廓帖木兒遣兵攻雁門，指揮吳均擊卻之。

translations.literal: On renchen, Köke Temür dispatched troops to attack Yanmen; Commander Wu Jun repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Köke Temür sent troops to attack Yanmen, and Commander Wu Jun repelled them.

sentences.zh: 是月，免北平、河間、河南、開封、延安、汾州被災田租。

translations.literal: That month, disaster-stricken land rent was remitted in Beiping, Hejian, Henan, Kaifeng, Yan'an, and Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month he remitted disaster-stricken land rent in Beiping, Hejian, Henan, Kaifeng, Yan'an, and Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，命戶部稽渡江以來各省水旱災傷分數，優恤之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on renyin, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to verify the degrees of flood and drought disaster and injury in each province since the crossing of the river, and provide preferential relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renyin, he ordered the Ministry of Revenue to verify flood and drought damage in each province since the crossing of the Yangzi and provide preferential relief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，胡惟庸為右丞相，八月乙亥，詔祀三皇及歷代帝王。

translations.literal: On renzi, Hu Weiyong became right chief minister; in the eighth month, on yihai, an edict ordered sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns and emperors of successive dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Hu Weiyong became right chief minister; in the eighth month, on yihai, he ordered sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns and emperors of successive dynasties.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，召徐達、馮勝還。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinsi, Xu Da and Feng Sheng were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinsi, Xu Da and Feng Sheng were recalled.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，擴廓帖木兒犯大同，徐達遣將擊敗之，達仍留鎮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renzi, Köke Temür invaded Datong; Xu Da dispatched generals who defeated him, and Da remained to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renzi, Köke Temür invaded Datong; Xu Da sent generals who defeated him, and Xu Da remained to garrison the region.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣兵部尚書劉仁振真定饑。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Minister of War Liu Ren was dispatched to relieve famine in Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he sent Minister of War Liu Ren to relieve famine in Zhending.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，冬至，帝不豫，改卜郊。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the winter solstice; the emperor was unwell and the suburban sacrifice was postponed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the winter solstice, the emperor was unwell and the suburban sacrifice was postponed.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙亥，錄故功臣子孫未嗣者二百九人。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on yihai, descendants of former meritorious officials without heirs were recorded—two hundred nine persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yihai, he recorded two hundred nine descendants of former meritorious officials who had no heirs.

sentences.zh: 壬午，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: On renwu, rites were performed at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he performed rites at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，頒定《大明律》。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the fixed Great Ming Code was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he promulgated the fixed Great Ming Code.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、高麗、占城、真臘、三佛齊入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam, Goryeo, Champa, Zhenla, and Sanfoqi sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam, Goryeo, Champa, Zhenla, and Sanfoqi sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 命安南陳叔明權知國事。

translations.literal: Chen Shuming of Annan was ordered to act as regent of state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shuming of Annan was authorized to act as regent of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲戌，都督僉事王簡、王誠、平章李伯升屯田河南、山東、北平。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, the first month, on jiaxu, Regional Commander Wang Jian and Wang Cheng and Pingzhang Li Bosheng garrisoned fields in Henan, Shandong, and Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on jiaxu of the first month of spring, Regional Commanders Wang Jian and Wang Cheng and Pingzhang Li Bosheng organized garrison farming in Henan, Shandong, and Beiping.

sentences.zh: 靖海侯吳禎為總兵官，都督於顯副之，巡海捕倭。

translations.literal: Marquis of Pacifying the Sea Wu Zhen became overall military officer, with Regional Commander Yu Xian as deputy, patrolling the sea to capture Wo pirates.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhen, Marquis of Pacifying the Sea, was made overall military officer with Regional Commander Yu Xian as deputy, to patrol the sea and capture Japanese pirates.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingyou, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, dingyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊午，修曲阜孔子廟，設孔、顏、孟三氏學。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Confucius temple at Qufu was repaired and schools for the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans were established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he repaired the Confucius temple at Qufu and established schools for the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans.

sentences.zh: 是月，平陽、太原、汾州、曆城、汲縣旱蝗，並免租稅。

translations.literal: That month, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Fenzhou, Licheng, and Jixian suffered drought and locusts; rent and tax were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month he remitted rent and tax in Pingyang, Taiyuan, Fenzhou, Licheng, and Jixian, which suffered drought and locusts.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，都督藍玉敗元兵於白酒泉，遂拔興和。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jihai, Regional Commander Lan Yu defeated Yuan troops at White Wine Spring and then took Xinghe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jihai, Regional Commander Lan Yu defeated Yuan troops at White Wine Spring and then took Xinghe.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金吾指揮陸齡討永、道諸州蠻，平之。

translations.literal: On renyin, Golden Guard Commander Lu Ling suppressed the barbarians of Yong and Dao prefectures and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Golden Guard Commander Lu Ling suppressed the barbarians of Yong and Dao prefectures and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，免真定等四十二禕府州縣被災田租。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingzi, land rent was remitted in forty-two prefectures, departments, and counties of Zhending and elsewhere that suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingzi, he remitted disaster-stricken land rent in forty-two prefectures, departments, and counties including Zhending.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，振蘇州饑民三十萬戶。

translations.literal: On xinsi, three hundred thousand famine households in Suzhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he provided relief to three hundred thousand famine households in Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，減蘇、松、嘉、湖極重田租之半。

translations.literal: On guisi, the extremely heavy land rent of Su, Song, Jia, and Hu was reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he reduced by half the extremely heavy land rent of Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，陝西平涼、延安、靖寧、鄜州雨雹，山西、山東、北平、河南蝗，並蠲田租。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Pingliang, Yan'an, Jingning, and Fuzhou in Shaanxi had hail; Shanxi, Shandong, Beiping, and Henan had locusts; land rent was all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month hail struck Pingliang, Yan'an, Jingning, and Fuzhou in Shaanxi, and locusts struck Shanxi, Shandong, Beiping, and Henan; land rent was remitted in all affected areas.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，李文忠破元兵於大寧、高州。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiazi, Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan troops at Daning and Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiazi, Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan troops at Daning and Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，倭寇登、萊。

translations.literal: On renshen, Wo pirates raided Deng and Lai.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Japanese pirates raided Deng and Lai.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午朔，祀歷代帝王廟。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiawu, the first day of the month, sacrifice was made at the temple of emperors of successive dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, jiawu, he sacrificed at the temple of emperors of successive dynasties.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔軍士陣歿父母妻子不能自存者，官為存養。

translations.literal: On xinchou, an edict ordered that where soldiers died in battle and parents, wives, and children could not support themselves, the government was to preserve and nurture them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he ordered that where soldiers died in battle and their parents, wives, and children could not support themselves, the government was to care for them.

sentences.zh: 百姓避兵離散或客死，遺老幼，並資遣還。

translations.literal: Where common people fled war and scattered, or died as guests leaving old and young behind—all were given resources and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Where common people fled war and scattered, or died away from home leaving old and young behind, all were given resources and sent home.

sentences.zh: 遠宦卒官，妻子不能歸者，有司給舟車資送。

translations.literal: Where officials died in office far from home and wives and children could not return, responsible offices were to provide boats, carts, and funds to escort them.
translations.idiomatic: Where officials died in distant posts and their wives and children could not return home, local offices were to provide boats, carts, and funds to escort them.

sentences.zh: 庚申，振河間、廣平、順德、真定饑，蠲租稅。

translations.literal: On gengshen, famine in Hejian, Guangping, Shunde, and Zhending was relieved and rent and tax remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he provided famine relief in Hejian, Guangping, Shunde, and Zhending and remitted rent and tax.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，遣崇禮侯買的裏八剌歸，遺元嗣君書。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingchou, Marquis of Chongli Maidiliba was sent back with a letter to the Yuan heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingchou, he sent Marquis of Chongli Maidiliba home with a letter to the Yuan heir.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬戌，納哈出犯遼陽，千戶吳壽擊走之。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on renxu, Naghachu invaded Liaoyang; Commander Wu Shou attacked and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on renxu, Naghachu invaded Liaoyang and Commander Wu Shou drove him off.

sentences.zh: 辛未，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: On xinwei, rites were performed at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he performed rites at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，召鄧愈、湯和還。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Deng Yu and Tang He were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Deng Yu and Tang He were recalled.

sentences.zh: 是年，阿難功德國、暹羅、琉球、三佛齊、烏斯藏、撒裏、畏兀兒入貢。

translations.literal: That year, the State of Ananade, Siam, Ryukyu, Sanfoqi, U-Tsang, Sali, and Uighur sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year the State of Ananade, Siam, Ryukyu, Sanfoqi, U-Tsang, Sali, and the Uighurs sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月辛未，增祀雞籠山功臣廟一百八人。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, spring, the first month, on xinwei, sacrifice at the meritorious officials' temple on Jilong Mountain was increased by one hundred eight persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on xinwei of the first month of spring, he added one hundred eight names to the meritorious officials' temple on Cock's Cage Mountain.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命有司察窮民無告者，給屋舍衣食。

translations.literal: On guiyou, responsible offices were ordered to investigate impoverished people with no one to plead for them and provide housing, food, and clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he ordered officials to investigate destitute people with no one to speak for them and provide housing, food, and clothing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，鄧愈、湯和等十三人屯戍北平、陝西、河南。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Deng Yu, Tang He, and thirteen others garrisoned Beiping, Shaanxi, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Deng Yu, Tang He, and thirteen others garrisoned Beiping, Shaanxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔天下立社學。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict ordered community schools established throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he ordered community schools established throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 是月，河決開封，發民夫塞之。

translations.literal: That month, the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng and corvée laborers were mobilized to block it.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng and he mobilized laborers to block it.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，宥雜犯死罪以下及官犯私罪者，謫鳳陽輸作屯種贖罪。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiawu, those guilty of miscellaneous crimes below death and officials guilty of private crimes were pardoned and relegated to Fengyang to perform labor and garrison farming to redeem guilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiawu, he pardoned those guilty of miscellaneous crimes below death and officials guilty of private crimes, relegating them to Fengyang to perform labor and garrison farming to redeem their guilt.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On guichou, the ceremonial plowing field was tilled.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he performed the ceremonial plowing of the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 召徐達、李文忠、馮勝還，傅友德等留鎮北平。

translations.literal: Xu Da, Li Wenzhong, and Feng Sheng were recalled; Fu Youde and others remained to garrison Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da, Li Wenzhong, and Feng Sheng were recalled while Fu Youde and others remained to garrison Beiping.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，立鈔法。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinyou, paper currency regulations were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinyou, he established paper currency regulations.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷寶源局鑄錢。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Baoyuan Bureau coin mint was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he abolished coin minting at the Baoyuan Bureau.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，幸中都。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on xinmao, the emperor visited the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinmao, he visited the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，至自中都。

translations.literal: On dingsi, he arrived from the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he returned from the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 免彰德、大名、臨洮、平涼、河州被災田租。

translations.literal: Disaster-stricken land rent was remitted in Zhangde, Daming, Lintao, Pingliang, and Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted disaster-stricken land rent in Zhangde, Daming, Lintao, Pingliang, and Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 罷營中都。

translations.literal: Construction of the Central Capital was halted.
translations.idiomatic: He halted construction of the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 致仕誠意怕劉基卒。

translations.literal: Retired Earl of Sincere Intent Liu Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji, retired Earl of Sincere Intent, died.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，永嘉候硃亮祖偕傅友德鎮北平。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jisi, Yongjia Marquis Zhu Liangzu together with Fu Youde garrisoned Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi, Zhu Liangzu, Marquis of Yongjia, together with Fu Youde garrisoned Beiping.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，指揮同知胡汝平貴州蠻。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renyin, Commander Vice Director Hu Ruping pacified the Guizhou barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renyin, Vice Director of Command Hu Ruping pacified the Guizhou barbarians.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiwei, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, jiwei, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，改作太廟。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Grand Temple was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he rebuilt the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，召傅友德、硃亮祖還，李文忠、顧時鎮山西、北平。

translations.literal: On renxu, Fu Youde and Zhu Liangzu were recalled; Li Wenzhong and Gu Shi garrisoned Shanxi and Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Fu Youde and Zhu Liangzu were recalled while Li Wenzhong and Gu Shi garrisoned Shanxi and Beiping.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔百官奔父母喪不俟報。

translations.literal: On wuchen, an edict ordered all officials to hurry home for parents' funerals without awaiting approval.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he ordered all officials to hurry home for parents' funerals without awaiting approval.

sentences.zh: 京師地震。

translations.literal: The capital region had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免應天、太平、甯國鎮江及蘄、黃諸府被災田租。

translations.literal: On dingchou, disaster-stricken land rent was remitted in Yingtian, Taiping, Ningguo, Zhenjiang, and the prefectures of Qi and Huang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he remitted disaster-stricken land rent in Yingtian, Taiping, Ningguo, Zhenjiang, and the prefectures of Qi and Huang.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，元擴廓帖木兒卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiyou, the Yuan Köke Temür died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, the Yuan minister Köke Temür died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，詔舉富民素行端潔達時務者。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on dinghai, an edict sought wealthy commoners of upright conduct who understood current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dinghai, he issued an edict seeking wealthy commoners of upright conduct who understood current affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命皇太子諸王講武中都。

translations.literal: On renzi, the crown prince and princes were ordered to practice martial arts at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he ordered the crown prince and princes to practice martial arts at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，有事於圓丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, rites were performed at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, he performed rites at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuzi, the capital region had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuzi, the capital region was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣使振蘇州、湖州、嘉興、松江、常州、太平、甯國、杭州水災。

translations.literal: On jiayin, envoys were dispatched to relieve flood disaster in Suzhou, Huzhou, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Changzhou, Taiping, Ningguo, and Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he sent envoys to relieve flood disaster in Suzhou, Huzhou, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Changzhou, Taiping, Ningguo, and Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，納哈出犯遼東，指揮馬雲、葉旺大敗之。

translations.literal: That month, Naghachu invaded Liaodong; Commanders Ma Yun and Ye Wang greatly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Naghachu invaded Liaodong and Commanders Ma Yun and Ye Wang routed him.

sentences.zh: 是年，撒裏、高麗、占城、暹羅、日本、爪哇、三佛齊入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Sali, Goryeo, Champa, Siam, Japan, Java, and Sanfoqi sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Sali, Goryeo, Champa, Siam, Japan, Java, and Sanfoqi sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月，中山侯湯和，潁川侯傅友德，都督僉事藍玉、王弼，中書右丞丁玉，備邊延安。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, the first month, Zhongshan Marquis Tang He, Yingchuan Marquis Fu Youde, Regional Commanders Lan Yu and Wang Bi, and Right Vice Director Ding Yu guarded the border at Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, in the first month of spring, Tang He, Marquis of Zhongshan, Fu Youde, Marquis of Yingchuan, Regional Commanders Lan Yu and Wang Bi, and Right Vice Director Ding Yu guarded the border at Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，詔曰：「比年西征燉煌，北伐沙漠，軍需甲仗，皆資山、陝，又以秦、晉二府宮殿之役，重困吾民。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jimao, an edict said: "In recent years the western campaign reached Dunhuang and the northern campaign reached the desert; military supplies and armor all relied on Shanxi and Shaanxi, and moreover the palace construction of the Qin and Jin princely establishments heavily burdened Our people.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jimao, he issued an edict: "In recent years the western campaign reached Dunhuang and the northern campaign the desert; military supplies and armor all came from Shanxi and Shaanxi, and the palace construction of the Qin and Jin princely establishments has heavily burdened my people.

sentences.zh: 平定以來，閭閻未息。

translations.literal: Since pacification, the lanes and wards have not rested.
translations.idiomatic: Since pacification the common people have not rested.

sentences.zh: 國都始建，土木屢興。

translations.literal: The capital was first established and earth and timber works arose repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: The capital was newly established and construction arose repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 畿輔既極煩勞，外郡疲於轉運。

translations.literal: The metropolitan region was taxed to the utmost; outer commanderies were exhausted by transport.
translations.idiomatic: The metropolitan region has been taxed to the utmost, and outer commanderies exhausted by transport.

sentences.zh: 今蓄儲有餘，其淮、揚、安、徽、池五府及山西、陝西、河南、福建、江西、浙江、北平、湖廣今年租賦，悉免之。」

translations.literal: Now stores are sufficient; the five prefectures of Huai, Yang, An, Hui, and Chi and Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, Fujian, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Beiping, and Huguang—all this year's rent and tax are entirely remitted."
translations.idiomatic: Now stores are sufficient; rent and tax for this year are entirely remitted in the five prefectures of Huai, Yang, An, Hui, and Chi and in Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, Fujian, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Beiping, and Huguang."

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，京師自去年八月不雨，是日始雨。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on gengxu, the capital had had no rain since the eighth month of last year; on this day rain began.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengxu, rain finally fell in the capital, which had had no rain since the eighth month of the previous year.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，自庚戌雨，至是日始霽。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guiyou, from gengxu rain fell until this day it cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiyou, rain that had fallen since gengxu finally cleared.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，改行中書省為承宣佈政使司。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiawu, the Branch Secretariat was changed to the Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiawu, he changed the Branch Secretariat to the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，李文忠還。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Li Wenzhong returned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Li Wenzhong returned.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on guichou, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, guichou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲蘇、松、嘉、湖水災田租，振永平旱災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster land rent was remitted in Su, Song, Jia, and Hu, and Yongping drought disaster was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month he remitted flood disaster land rent in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou and provided drought relief in Yongping.

sentences.zh: 元將伯顏帖木兒犯延安，傅友德敗降之。

translations.literal: The Yuan general Bayan Temür invaded Yan'an; Fu Youde defeated and accepted his surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan general Bayan Temür invaded Yan'an; Fu Youde defeated him and accepted his surrender.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，遣官省歷代帝王陵寢，禁芻牧，置守陵戶。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiyou, officials were dispatched to inspect tombs of emperors of successive dynasties, forbidding grazing and cutting grass, and establishing tomb-guard households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, he sent officials to inspect tombs of emperors of successive dynasties, forbade grazing, and established tomb-guard households.

sentences.zh: 忠臣烈士祠，有司以時葺治。

translations.literal: Shrines to loyal ministers and martyrs were to be repaired seasonally by responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: Shrines to loyal ministers and martyrs were to be repaired seasonally by local officials.

sentences.zh: 分遣國子生修嶽鎮海瀆祠。

translations.literal: National University students were separately dispatched to repair shrines of peaks, mountains, and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: He separately dispatched National University students to repair shrines of peaks, mountains, and rivers.

sentences.zh: 西番朵兒只巴寇罕東，河州指揮甯正擊走之。

translations.literal: The Western Tibetan Dorbajiba raided Han East; Hezhou Commander Ning Zheng attacked and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Tibetan Dorbajiba raided Han East; Hezhou Commander Ning Zheng attacked and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 閏九月庚寅，以災異詔求直言。

translations.literal: In the intercalary ninth month, on gengyin, because of calamities and anomalies an edict sought frank counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, on gengyin, in response to calamities and anomalies he issued an edict seeking frank counsel.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，太廟成，自是行合享禮。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiwei, the Grand Temple was completed; from this the collective offering rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei, the Grand Temple was completed, and from this the collective offering rite was performed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命秦、晉、燕、吳、楚、齊諸王治兵鳳陽。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the kings of Qin, Jin, Yan, Wu, Chu, and Qi were ordered to drill troops at Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he ordered the kings of Qin, Jin, Yan, Wu, Chu, and Qi to drill troops at Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，有事於圓丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renwu, rites were performed at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renwu, he performed rites at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 戊子，徙山西及真定民無產者田鳳陽。

translations.literal: On wuzi, people of Shanxi and Zhending without property were relocated to farm at Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he relocated propertyless people from Shanxi and Zhending to farm at Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，振畿內、浙江、湖北水災。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiayin, flood disaster within the capital region, Zhejiang, and Hubei was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiayin, he provided relief for flood disaster in the capital region, Zhejiang, and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣都督同知沐英乘傳詣陝西問民疾苦。

translations.literal: On jimao, Vice Regional Commander Mu Ying was dispatched by rapid relay to Shaanxi to inquire into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he dispatched Vice Regional Commander Mu Ying by rapid relay to Shaanxi to inquire into the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 是年，覽邦、琉球、安南、日本、烏斯藏、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Lanbang, Ryukyu, Annan, Japan, U-Tsang, and Goryeo sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Lanbang, Ryukyu, Annan, Japan, U-Tsang, and Goryeo sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月辛卯，以羽林等衛軍益秦、晉、燕三府護衛。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, the first month, on xinmao, the guards of the Qin, Jin, and Yan princely establishments were increased with troops from the Feathered Forest and other guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on xinmao of the first month of spring, he increased the guards of the Qin, Jin, and Yan princely establishments with troops from the Feathered Forest and other guards.

sentences.zh: 是春，振蘇、松、嘉、湖水災。

translations.literal: That spring, flood disaster in Su, Song, Jia, and Hu was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That spring he provided relief for flood disaster in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，鄧愈為征西將軍，沐英為副將軍，率師討吐番，大破之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiyou, Deng Yu became western campaign general, with Mu Ying as deputy general, leading an army to campaign against the Tibetans and greatly defeating them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou, Deng Yu was made western campaign general with Mu Ying as deputy, leading an army against the Tibetans and routing them.

sentences.zh: 是月，振太平、甯國及宜興、錢塘諸縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in Taiping, Ningguo, and the counties of Yixing and Qiantang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month he provided relief for flood disaster in Taiping, Ningguo, and the counties of Yixing and Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，韓國公李善長、曹國公李文忠總中書省、大都督府、御史台，議軍國重事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengzi, Duke of Han Li Shanchang and Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong jointly directed the Secretariat, the Chief Military Commission, and the Censorate to deliberate important state and military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengzi, Li Shanchang, Duke of Han, and Li Wenzhong, Duke of Cao, jointly directed the Secretariat, the Chief Military Commission, and the Censorate to deliberate important state and military affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，振湖廣水災。

translations.literal: On guimao, Huguang flood disaster was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he provided relief for flood disaster in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，戶部主事趙乾振荊、蘄遲緩，伏誅。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Ministry of Revenue Director Zhao Gan was slow in relieving Jing and Qi; he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zhao Gan, a director in the Ministry of Revenue, was executed for delaying relief in Jing and Qi.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，詔臣民言事者，實封達御前。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingsi, an edict ordered that those among officials and commoners who spoke on affairs were to have their memorials sealed in fact and delivered before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingsi, he ordered that memorials from officials and commoners be sealed and delivered directly to the throne.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命政事啟皇太子裁決奏聞。

translations.literal: On bingyin, government affairs were ordered to be submitted to the crown prince for decision and then reported.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he ordered that government affairs be submitted to the crown prince for decision and then reported.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，置通政司。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiashen, the Office of Transmission was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiashen, he established the Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 是月，始遣御史巡按州縣。

translations.literal: That month, censors were first dispatched to inspect prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month he first dispatched censors to inspect prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，改建大祀殿於南郊。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengxu, the Great Sacrifice Hall at the Southern Suburb was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu, he rebuilt the Great Sacrifice Hall at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，選武臣子弟讀書國子監。

translations.literal: On guichou, sons of military officials were selected to study at the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he selected sons of military officials to study at the National University.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，振紹興、金華、衢州水災。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen, flood disaster in Shaoxing, Jinhua, and Quzhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingshen, he provided relief for flood disaster in Shaoxing, Jinhua, and Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，胡惟庸為左丞相，汪廣洋為右丞相。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Hu Weiyong became left chief minister and Wang Guangyang right chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Hu Weiyong became left chief minister and Wang Guangyang right chief minister.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，封沐英四平侯。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wuwu, Mu Ying was enfeoffed Marquis of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu, Mu Ying was enfeoffed Marquis of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜百官公田。

translations.literal: On xinyou, public fields were granted to all officials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he granted public fields to all officials.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，衛國公鄧愈卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, Duke of Wei Deng Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, Deng Yu, Duke of Wei, died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，合祀天地於奉天殿。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Hall of Complying with Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth in the Hall of Complying with Heaven.

sentences.zh: 是月，免河南、陝西、廣東、湖廣田租。

translations.literal: That month, land rent was remitted in Henan, Shaanxi, Guangdong, and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: That month he remitted land rent in Henan, Shaanxi, Guangdong, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 威茂蠻叛，御史大夫丁玉為平羌將軍，討平之。

translations.literal: The Weimao barbarians rebelled; Censor-in-chief Ding Yu became Pacify Qiang general and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: The Weimao barbarians rebelled; Ding Yu, censor-in-chief, was made Pacify Qiang general and suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yisi, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, yisi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁未，錄故功臣子孫百百餘人，授官有差。

translations.literal: On dingwei, descendants of former meritorious officials numbering more than one hundred were recorded and given offices in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he recorded more than one hundred descendants of former meritorious officials and appointed them to offices in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、三佛齊、暹羅、爪哇、真臘入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Sanfoqi, Siam, Java, and Zhenla sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Champa, Sanfoqi, Siam, Java, and Zhenla sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 高麗使五至，以嗣王未立，卻之。

translations.literal: Goryeo envoys came five times; because the heir king was not yet established, they were declined.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo envoys came five times, but because the heir king was not yet established, their tribute was declined.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月甲戌，封皇子椿為蜀王，柏湘王，桂豫王，模漢王，植衛王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, spring, the first month, on jiaxu, the princes Chun was enfeoffed King of Shu, Bai King of Xiang, Gui King of Yu, Mo King of Han, and Zhi King of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on jiaxu of the first month of spring, he enfeoffed his sons Chun as King of Shu, Bai as King of Xiang, Gui as King of Yu, Mo as King of Han, and Zhi as King of Wei.

sentences.zh: 改封吳王橚為周王。

translations.literal: King of Wu Chu was changed to King of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Wu, Chu, was redesignated King of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，進封湯和信國公。

translations.literal: On jimao, Tang He, Marquis of Zhongshan, was advanced to Duke of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Tang He, Marquis of Zhongshan, was advanced to Duke of Xin.

sentences.zh: 是月，徵天下布政使及知府來朝。

translations.literal: That month, provincial administration commissioners and prefectural magistrates throughout the realm were summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: That month he summoned provincial administration commissioners and prefectural magistrates from across the empire to court.

sentences.zh: 二月，指揮胡淵平茂州蠻。

translations.literal: In the second month, Commander Hu Yuan pacified the Maozhou barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Commander Hu Yuan pacified the Maozhou barbarians.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，命奏事毋關白中書省。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renwu, memorials were ordered not to pass through the Secretariat for clearance.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renwu, he ordered that memorials not pass through the Secretariat for clearance.

sentences.zh: 是月，第來朝官為三等。

translations.literal: That month, officials coming to court were ranked in three grades.
translations.idiomatic: That month he ranked officials coming to court in three grades.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，元嗣君愛猷識理達臘殂，子脫古思帖木兒嗣。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the Yuan heir Ayushiridara died and his son Toghus Temür succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer the Yuan heir Ayushiridara died and his son Toghus Temür succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，存問蘇、松、嘉、湖被水災民，戶賜米一石，蠲逋賦六十五萬有奇。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingyou, people of Su, Song, Jia, and Hu stricken by flood were inquired after; one shi of grain per household was granted and more than 650,000 in arrears of tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingyou, he inquired after people of Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou stricken by flood, granted one shi of grain per household, and remitted more than 650,000 in tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，遣使祭故元嗣君。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renzi, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the former Yuan heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi, he sent envoys to sacrifice to the former Yuan heir.

sentences.zh: 己巳，五開蠻叛，殺靖州指揮過興，以辰州指揮楊仲名為總兵官，討之。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Wukai barbarians rebelled and killed Jingzhou Commander Guo Xing; Chenzhou Commander Yang Zhongming was made overall military officer to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Wukai barbarians rebelled and killed Jingzhou Commander Guo Xing; Yang Zhongming, commander of Chenzhou, was made overall military officer to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，振平陽饑。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingchou, Pingyang famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingchou, he provided famine relief in Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 是月，蘇、松、揚、臺海溢，遣官存恤。

translations.literal: That month, Su, Song, Yang, and Tai seas overflowed; officials were dispatched to preserve and succor.
translations.idiomatic: That month the seas at Suzhou, Songjiang, Yangzhou, and Taizhou overflowed, and he sent officials to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 八月，免應天、太平、鎮江、甯國、廣德諸府州秋糧。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, autumn grain tax was remitted in the prefectures of Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he remitted autumn grain tax in the prefectures of Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，追封劉繼祖為義惠侯。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen, Liu Jizu was posthumously enfeoffed Marquis of Righteous Favor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingshen, Liu Jizu was posthumously enfeoffed Marquis of Righteous Favor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，大祀殿成。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiazi, the Great Sacrifice Hall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi, the Great Sacrifice Hall was completed.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，征西將軍西平侯沐英率都督藍玉、玉弼討西番。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengwu, Western Campaign General Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying led Regional Commanders Lan Yu and Wang Bi to campaign against the Western Barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengwu, Mu Ying, Marquis of Xiping and western campaign general, led Regional Commanders Lan Yu and Wang Bi against the Western Barbarians.

sentences.zh: 是月，五開蠻平。

translations.literal: That month, the Wukai barbarians were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Wukai barbarians were pacified.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、闍婆、高麗、琉球、占城、三佛齊、朵甘、烏斯藏、彭亨、百花入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam, Java, Goryeo, Ryukyu, Champa, Sanfoqi, Do-kham, U-Tsang, Pahang, and Baihua sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam, Java, Goryeo, Ryukyu, Champa, Sanfoqi, Do-kham, U-Tsang, Pahang, and Baihua sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月己卯，始合禮天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, spring, the first month, on jimao, Heaven and Earth were first jointly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, on jimao of the first month of spring, he first jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 甲申，洮州十八族番叛，命沐英移兵討之。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the eighteen tribes of Taozhou rebelled; Mu Ying was ordered to move troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the eighteen tribes of Taozhou rebelled, and Mu Ying was ordered to move troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，丁玉平松州蠻。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Ding Yu pacified the Songzhou barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Ding Yu pacified the Songzhou barbarians.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，李文忠督理河、岷、臨、鞏軍事。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuxu, Li Wenzhong supervised military affairs of He, Min, Lin, and Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuxu, Li Wenzhong supervised military affairs in He, Min, Lin, and Gong.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔曰：「今春雨雪經旬。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict said: "Now spring rain and snow have lasted more than ten days.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he issued an edict: "Spring rain and snow have now lasted more than ten days.

sentences.zh: 天下貧民困於饑寒者多有，其令有司給以鈔。

translations.literal: Poor people throughout the realm suffering from hunger and cold are many; responsible offices are ordered to give them paper money.
translations.idiomatic: Many poor people throughout the empire suffer hunger and cold; I order local officials to give them paper money.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，信國公湯和率列候練兵臨清。

translations.literal: " On bingyin, Duke of Xin Tang He led the ranked marquises to drill troops at Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingyin Tang He, Duke of Xin, led the ranked marquises to drill troops at Linqing.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸未，蠲北平田租。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on guiwei, Beiping land rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on guiwei, he remitted land rent in Beiping.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，都督馬雲征大寧。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingmao, Regional Commander Ma Yun campaigned against Daning.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao, Regional Commander Ma Yun campaigned against Daning.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，丁玉回師討眉縣賊，平之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on bingchen, Ding Yu returned the army to suppress bandits in Meixian and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, Ding Yu brought the army back to suppress bandits in Meixian and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 己未，李文忠還掌大都督府事。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Li Wenzhong returned to direct affairs of the Chief Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Wenzhong returned to direct affairs of the Chief Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，詔凡致仕官復其家，終身無所與。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinsi, an edict ordered that retired officials' families be restored and that they owe nothing for life.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinsi, he ordered that the families of retired officials be restored and exempted from obligations for life.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，沐英大破西番，擒其部長三副使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jihai, Mu Ying greatly defeated the Western Barbarians and captured three of their vice chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jihai, Mu Ying routed the Western Barbarians and captured three of their vice chieftains.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲午，沐英班師，封仇成、藍玉等十二人為侯。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on jiawu, Mu Ying returned the army; Qiu Cheng, Lan Yu, and twelve others were enfeoffed as marquises.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiawu, Mu Ying returned the army; Qiu Cheng, Lan Yu, and twelve others were enfeoffed as marquises.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大寧平。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Daning was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Daning was pacified.

sentences.zh: 十二月，汪廣洋貶廣南，賜死。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Wang Guangyang was demoted to Guangnan and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Wang Guangyang was demoted to Guangnan and ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 徵天下博學老成之士至京師。

translations.literal: Learned and elderly accomplished scholars throughout the realm were summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned learned and accomplished elderly scholars from across the empire to the capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、爪哇、暹羅、日本、安南、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Java, Siam, Japan, Annan, and Goryeo sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Champa, Java, Siam, Japan, Annan, and Goryeo sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 高麗貢黃金百斤、白金萬兩，以不如約，卻之。

translations.literal: Goryeo presented one hundred jin of gold and ten thousand liang of silver; because it did not accord with the agreement, it was declined.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo presented one hundred jin of gold and ten thousand liang of silver, but because it did not accord with the agreement, the tribute was declined.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月戊戌，左丞相胡惟庸謀反，及其黨御史大夫陳甯、中丞塗節等伏誅。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, spring, the first month, on wuxu, Left Chief Minister Hu Weiyong plotted rebellion; he and his faction Censor-in-chief Chen Ning, Vice Censor Zhong Tu, and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, on wuxu of the first month of spring, Left Chief Minister Hu Weiyong plotted rebellion; he and his associates Chen Ning, censor-in-chief, Zhong Tu, vice censor, and others were executed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On guimao, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 罷中書省，廢丞相等官，更定六部官秩，改大都督府為中、左、右、前、後五軍都督府。

translations.literal: The Secretariat was abolished and the offices of chief minister and others eliminated; the official ranks of the Six Ministries were revised; the Chief Military Commission was changed to the five military commissions of Central, Left, Right, Front, and Rear.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished the Secretariat and the office of chief minister, revised the ranks of the Six Ministries, and divided the Chief Military Commission into the five military commissions of Central, Left, Right, Front, and Rear.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌朔，詔舉聰明正直、孝弟力田、賢良方正、文學術數之士。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renxu, the first day of the month, an edict sought men of clear intelligence and upright conduct, filial piety and field labor, worthy talent and upright character, and literary and numerological learning.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, renxu, he issued an edict seeking men of clear intelligence, upright conduct, filial piety, field labor, worthy talent, literary learning, and numerological skill.

sentences.zh: 發丹符，驗天下金穀之數。

translations.literal: Red tallies were issued to verify the empire's gold and grain accounts.
translations.idiomatic: He issued red tallies to verify gold and grain accounts throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，文武官年六十以上者聽致仕，給以誥敕。

translations.literal: On wuchen, civil and military officials aged sixty and above were permitted to retire, and patent letters of appointment were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he permitted civil and military officials aged sixty and above to retire and granted them patent letters of appointment.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，減蘇、松、嘉、湖重賦十之二。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renchen, the heavy levies of Su, Song, Jia, and Hu were reduced by two tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen, he reduced the heavy levies of Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou by two tenths.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，燕王隸之國北平。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Prince of Yan took up his fief at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Prince of Yan took up his fief at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 壬子，沐英襲元將脫火赤於亦集乃，擒之，盡降其眾。

translations.literal: On renzi, Mu Ying raided the Yuan general Tohochu at Ejinay and captured him; all his forces surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Mu Ying raided the Yuan general Tohochu at Ejinay, captured him, and accepted the surrender of his entire force.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，命群臣各舉所知。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jichou, the various ministers were each ordered to recommend men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jichou, he ordered each minister to recommend men he knew.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，雷震謹身殿。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiawu, lightning struck the Hall of Self-Cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiawu, lightning struck the Hall of Self-Cultivation.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大赦。

translations.literal: On yiwei, a general amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he granted a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丙申，釋在京及臨濠屯田輸作者。

translations.literal: On bingshen, those performing labor at the capital and at Linhuang garrison farms were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he released those performing labor at the capital and at Linhuang garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免天下田租。

translations.literal: On jihai, land rent throughout the realm was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he remitted land rent throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 吏以過誤罷者還其職。

translations.literal: Officials dismissed for minor errors were restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: Officials dismissed for minor errors were restored to office.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，都督濮英進兵赤斤站，獲故元豳王亦憐真及其部曲而還。

translations.literal: On renyin, Regional Commander Pu Ying advanced to Chijin Station, captured the former Yuan Prince of Bin Yilianzhen and his followers, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Regional Commander Pu Ying advanced to Chijin Station, captured the former Yuan Prince of Bin, Yilianzhen, and his followers, and returned.

sentences.zh: 是月，罷御史台。

translations.literal: That month, the Censorate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: That month he abolished the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 命從征士卒老疾者許以子代，老而無子及寡婦，有司資遣還。

translations.literal: Campaign soldiers who were old or ill were permitted to have sons substitute; those old without sons and widows were to be given resources and sent back by responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: Campaign soldiers who were old or ill were permitted to have sons substitute for them; those old without sons and widows were to be given resources and sent home by local officials.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，雷震奉天門，避正殿省愆。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingyin, lightning struck the Gate of Complying with Heaven; the emperor avoided the main hall and examined his faults.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingyin, lightning struck the Gate of Complying with Heaven, and the emperor avoided the main hall to examine his faults.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，罷王府工役。

translations.literal: On dingmao, corvée labor for princely establishments was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he abolished corvée labor for princely establishments.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，置諫院官。

translations.literal: On dingchou, remonstrance officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he established remonstrance officials.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，命天下學校師生，日給廩膳。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, teachers and students of schools throughout the realm were ordered given daily grain provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn he ordered daily grain provisions for teachers and students of schools throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，景川侯曹震、營陽侯楊璟、永城侯恭顯屯田北平。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinmao, Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen, Marquis of Yingyang Yang Jing, and Marquis of Yongcheng Gong Xian garrisoned fields at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao, Cao Zhen, Marquis of Jingchuan, Yang Jing, Marquis of Yingyang, and Gong Xian, Marquis of Yongcheng, organized garrison farming at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，天壽節，始受群臣朝賀，賜宴於謹身殿，後以為常。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Heavenly Longevity Festival; the emperor first received court congratulations from ministers and granted a banquet in the Hall of Self-Cultivation, afterward made the rule.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the Heavenly Longevity Festival, he first received congratulations from his ministers and granted a banquet in the Hall of Self-Cultivation, thereafter making it a standing practice.

sentences.zh: 丙午，置四輔官，告於太廟。

translations.literal: On bingwu, four assisting officials were established and announced at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he established four assisting officials and announced them at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 以儒士王本、估佑、襲斅、杜斅、趙民望、吳源為春、夏官。

translations.literal: The Confucian scholars Wang Ben, Hu You, Xi Zhuo, Du Zhuo, Zhao Minwang, and Wu Yuan were made spring and summer officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Confucian scholars Wang Ben, Hu You, Xi Zhuo, Du Zhuo, Zhao Minwang, and Wu Yuan were appointed spring and summer officials.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔陝西衛軍以三分之二屯田。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered Shaanxi guard troops to garrison farm two thirds of the time.
translations.idiomatic: That month he ordered Shaanxi guard troops to devote two thirds of their time to garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 安置翰林學士承旨宋濂於茂州，道卒。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Emeritus Song Lian was assigned to Maozhou and died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Emeritus Song Lian was assigned to Maozhou and died on the road.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙未，徐達還。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on yiwei, Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on yiwei, Xu Da returned.

sentences.zh: 丙午，元平章完者不花、乃兒不花犯永平，指揮劉廣戰沒，千戶王輅擊敗之，擒完者不花。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Yuan pingzhang Wanzehua and Erdenbu invaded Yongping; Commander Liu Guang died in battle; Commander Wang Luo defeated them and captured Wanzehua.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Yuan ministers Wanzehua and Erdenbu invaded Yongping; Commander Liu Guang died in battle; Commander Wang Luo defeated them and captured Wanzehua.

sentences.zh: 十二月，天下府州縣所舉士至者八百六十餘人，授官有差。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, more than eight hundred sixty scholars recommended by prefectures, departments, and counties throughout the realm arrived and were given offices in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month more than eight hundred sixty scholars recommended by prefectures and counties across the empire arrived and were appointed to offices in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 南雄侯趙庸鎮廣東，討陽春蠻。

translations.literal: Marquis of Nanxiong Zhao Yong garrisoned Guangdong and suppressed the Yangchun barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yong, Marquis of Nanxiong, garrisoned Guangdong and suppressed the Yangchun barbarians.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、日本、安南、占城、真臘、爪哇入貢，日本以無表卻之。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Japan, Annan, Champa, Zhenla, and Java sent tribute; Japan was declined for lack of a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu, Japan, Annan, Champa, Zhenla, and Java sent tribute; Japan was declined for lack of a formal memorial.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月戊子，徐達為征虜大將軍，湯和、傅友德為左、右副將軍，帥師討乃兒不花。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, spring, the first month, on wuzi, Xu Da became great general for the campaign against the barbarians; Tang He and Fu Youde became left and right deputy generals, leading an army to campaign against Erdenbu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on wuzi of the first month of spring, Xu Da was made great general for the northern campaign, with Tang He and Fu Youde as left and right deputy generals, to lead an army against Erdenbu.

sentences.zh: 命新授官者各舉所知。

translations.literal: Newly appointed officials were each ordered to recommend men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered each newly appointed official to recommend men he knew.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷天下歲造兵器。

translations.literal: On renzi, annual manufacture of weapons throughout the realm was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he abolished annual manufacture of weapons throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命公候子弟入國學。

translations.literal: On guichou, sons of dukes and marquises were ordered to enter the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he ordered sons of dukes and marquises to enter the National University.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔求隱逸。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict sought reclusive scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he issued an edict seeking reclusive scholars.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，核天下官田。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengchen, official fields throughout the realm were audited.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengchen, he audited official fields throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，大赦。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingxu, a general amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu, he granted a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，頒《五經》、《四書》於北方學校。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Five Classics and Four Books were promulgated to northern schools.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he promulgated the Five Classics and Four Books to schools in the north.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，徐達率諸將出塞，至北黃河，擊破元兵，獲全寧四部以歸。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on gengwu, Xu Da led the generals beyond the frontier to the Northern Yellow River, defeated Yuan troops, and returned with the four divisions of Quanning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengwu, Xu Da led his generals beyond the frontier to the Northern Yellow River, defeated Yuan troops, and returned with the four divisions of Quanning.

sentences.zh: 五月，五溪蠻叛，江夏侯周德興討平之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Wuxi barbarians rebelled; Jiangxia Marquis Zhou Dexing suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Wuxi barbarians rebelled, and Zhou Dexing, Marquis of Jiangxia, suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙子，詔求明經老成之士，有司禮送京師。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on bingzi, an edict sought elderly accomplished scholars versed in the classics; responsible offices were to escort them to the capital with ritual courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on bingzi, he issued an edict seeking elderly scholars versed in the classics, and ordered local officials to escort them to the capital with proper ceremony.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，河決原武、祥符、中牟。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Yellow River burst its banks at Yuanwu, Xiangfu, and Zhongmou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Yellow River burst its banks at Yuanwu, Xiangfu, and Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，徐達還。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Xu Da returned.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午朔，傅友德為征南將軍，藍玉、沐英為左、右副將軍，帥征支南。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renwu, the first day of the month, Fu Youde became southern campaign general, with Lan Yu and Mu Ying as left and right deputy generals, leading a campaign against Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, renwu, Fu Youde was made southern campaign general with Lan Yu and Mu Ying as left and right deputies, to lead a campaign against Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 徐達鎮北平。

translations.literal: Xu Da garrisoned Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da garrisoned Beiping.

sentences.zh: 丙午，周德興移師討施州蠻，平之。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Zhou Dexing moved the army to suppress the Shizhou barbarians and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zhou Dexing moved his army to suppress the Shizhou barbarians and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on renzi, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, renzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命法司錄囚，會翰林院給事中及春坊官會議平允以聞。

translations.literal: On guichou, the judiciary was ordered to record prisoners; Hanlin Academy supervising secretaries and Eastern Palace officials were to meet and discuss fairness and report.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he ordered the judiciary to review prisoners, with Hanlin supervising secretaries and Eastern Palace officials to meet, discuss fairness, and report.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免應天、太平、應德、鎮江、甯國田租。

translations.literal: On jiayin, land rent was remitted in Yingtian, Taiping, Guangde, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he remitted land rent in Yingtian, Taiping, Guangde, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，分遣御史錄囚。

translations.literal: On guihai, censors were separately dispatched to record prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he separately dispatched censors to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己卯，延安侯唐勝宗帥師討浙東山寇，平之。

translations.literal: On jimao, Yan'an Marquis Tang Shengzong led troops to suppress mountain bandits in eastern Zhe and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Tang Shengzong, Marquis of Yan'an, led troops to suppress mountain bandits in eastern Zhe and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，吉安侯陸仲亨鎮成都。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renwu, Ji'an Marquis Lu Zhongheng garrisoned Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renwu, Lu Zhongheng, Marquis of Ji'an, garrisoned Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，趙庸討廣州海寇，大破之。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Zhao Yong campaigned against sea bandits in Guangzhou and greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zhao Yong campaigned against sea bandits in Guangzhou and routed them.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，命翰林春坊官考駁諸司章奏。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, Hanlin and Eastern Palace officials were ordered to examine and assess memorials from the various offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, he ordered Hanlin and Eastern Palace officials to examine memorials from the various offices.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，傅友德大敗元兵於白石江，遂下曲靖。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Fu Youde greatly defeated Yuan troops at the White Stone River and then took Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Fu Youde routed Yuan troops at the White Stone River and then took Qujing.

sentences.zh: 壬申，元梁王把匝剌瓦爾密走普寧自殺。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Yuan Prince of Liang Bazalawarmi fled to Puning and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Yuan Prince of Liang, Bazalawarmi, fled to Puning and killed himself.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、安南、爪哇、朵甘、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam, Annan, Java, Do-kham, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam, Annan, Java, Do-kham, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 以安南寇思明，不納。

translations.literal: Because Annan raided Siming, tribute was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Because Annan had raided Siming, their tribute was not accepted.
